munitrayaṃ namaskṛtya taduktīḥ paribhāvya ca /
vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntakaumudīyaṃ viracyate //

hal // 14 //

iti māheśvarāṇi sūtrāṇy aṇādisaṃjñārthāni / eṣām antyā itaḥ / laṇsūtre 'kāraś ca / hakārādiṣv akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ //

SK 1 hal antyam (A 1.3.3)

hal iti sūtre 'antyam it syāt /

SK 2 ādir antyena (A 1.1.71)

antyenetā sahita ādir madhyagānāṃ svasya ca saṃññā syāt / iti halsaṃjñāyām / hal antyam upadeśe 'ntyaṃ hal it syāt / upadeśa ādyoccāraṇam / tato 'ṇajityādisaṃjñāsiddhau //

SK 3 upadeśe 'j anunāsika it (A 1.3.2)

upadeśe 'nunāsiko 'j itsaṃjñaḥ syāṭ / pratijñānunāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ / laṇsūtrasthāvarṇena sahoccāryamāṇo repho ralayoḥ saṃjñā / pratyāhāreṣv itāṃ na grahaṇam / anunāsika ityādinirdeśāt / na hy atra kakāre pare 'ckāryaṃ dṛśyate / ādir antyenety etatsūtreṇa kṛtāḥ saṃjñāḥ pratyāhāraśabdena vyavahriyante //

SK 4 ūkālo 'jjhrasvadīrghaplutaḥ (A 1.2.27)

uś ca ūś ca ū3ś ca vaḥ / vāṃ kāla iva kālo yasya so 'c kramād dhrasvadīrghaplutasaṃjñaḥ syāṭ / sa pratyekam udāttādibhedena tridhā //

SK 5 uccair udāttaḥ (A 1.2.29)

tālvādiṣu sabhāgeṣu sthāneṣūrdhvabhāge piṣpanno 'judāttasaṃjñaḥ syāt / ā ye //

SK 6 nīcair anudāttaḥ (A 1.2.30)

spaṣṭam / arvāṅ //

SK 7 samāhāraḥ svaritaḥ (A 1.2.31)

udāttānudāttatve varṇadharmau samāhriyete yasmin so 'c svaritasaṃjñaḥ syāt /

SK 8 tasyādita udāttam ardhahrasvam (A 1.2.32)

hrasvagrahaṇam atantram / svaritasyādito 'rdham udāttaṃ bodhyam / uttrarārdhaṃ tu pariśeṣād anudāttam / tasya codāttasvaritaparatve śravaṇaṃ spaṣṭam / anyatra tūdāttaśrutiḥ prātiśākhye prasiddhā / kva bośvāḥ / rathānāṃ na ye rāḥ / śatacakraṃ yohyaḥ / ityādiṣv audāttaḥ / agnim īḷe ityādāv udāttaśrutiḥ /  sa navavidho 'pi pratyekam anunāsikānanunāsikatvābhyāṃ dvidhā //

SK 9 mukhanāsikāvacano 'nunāsikaḥ (A 1.1.8)

mukhasahitanāsikayoccāryamāṇo varṇo 'nunāsikasaṃjñaḥ syāt / tad ittham / a i u ṛ eṣāṃ varṇānāṃ pratyekam aṣṭādaśa bhedāḥ / ḷvarṇasya dvādaśa / tasya dīrghābhāvāt / ecām api dvādaśa / teṣāṃ hrasvābhāvāt //

SK 10 tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ sarvaṇam (A 1.1.9)

tālvādisthānam ābhyantaraprayatnaś cety etaddvayaṃ yasya yena tulyaṃ tanmithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñaṃ syāt / akuhavisarvanīyānāṃ kaṇṭhaḥ / icuyaśānāṃ tālu / ṛṭuraṣāṇāṃ mūrdhā / ḷtulasānāṃ dantāḥ / upūpadhmānīyānām oṣṭhau / jamaṅaṇanānāṃ nāsikā ca / edaitoḥ kaṇṭhatālu / odautoḥ kaṇṭhoṣṭham / vakārasya dantoṣṭham / jihvāmūlīyasya jihvāmūlam / nāsikānukhārasya / iti sthānāni // yatno dvidhā / ābhyantaro bāhyaś ca / ādyaś caturdhā / spṛṣṭeṣatspṛṣṭavivṛtasaṃvṛtabhedāt / tatra spṛṣṭaṃ prayatanaṃ sparśānām / īṣatspṛṣṭam antasthānām / vivṛtam ūṣmaṇāṃ svarāṇāṃ ca / hrasvayāvarṇaysa prayoge saṃvṛtam / prakriyādaśāyāṃ tu vivṛtam eva / etac ca sūtrakāreṇa jñāpitam / tathāhi //

SK 11 a a (A 8.4.68)

iti vivṛtam anūdya saṃvṛto 'nena vidhīyate / asya cāṣṭādhyāyīṃ saṃpūrṇāṃ pratyasiddhatvāc chāstradṛṣṭyā vivṛtatvam asty eva / tathā ca sūtram //

SK 12 pūrvatrāsiddham (A 8.2.1)

adhikāro 'yam / tena sapādasaptādhyāyīṃ prati tripādyasiddhā tripādyām api pūrvaṃ prati paraṃ śāstram asiddhaṃ syāṭ / bāhyaprayatnas tv ekādaśadhā---vicāraḥ saṃvāraḥ śvāso nādo ghoṣo 'ghoṣo 'lpaprāṇo mahāprāṇa udātto 'ndāttaḥ svaritaś ceti / khayāṃ yamāḥ svayaḥ ka pau visargaḥ śara eva ca / ete śvāsānupradānā aghoṣāś ca vivṛṇvate // kaṇṭham anye tu ghoṣāḥ syuḥ saṃvṛtā nādabhāginaḥ / ayugmā vargayamagā yaṇaś cālpāsavaḥ smṛtāḥ // vargeṣv ādyānāṃ caturṇāṃ pañcame pare madhye yamo nāma pūrvasadṛśo varṇaḥ prātiśākhye prasiddhaḥ / palikknīḥ / cakhkhnatuḥ / aggniḥ / ghaghnantīty atra krameṇa kakhagaghebhyaḥ pare tatsadṛśā eva yamāḥ / tatra vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ khayas tathā teṣām eva yamāḥ jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyau visargaḥ śaṣasāś cety eteṣāṃ vivāraḥ śvāso 'ghoṣaś ca / anyeṣāṃ tu saṃvāro nādo ghoṣaś ca / vargāṇāṃ prathamatṛtīyapañcamāḥ prathamatṛtīyayamau yaralavāś cālpaprāṇāḥ / anye mahāprāṇā ity arthaḥ / bāhyaprayatnāś ca yady api savarṇasaṃjñāyām anupayuktās tathāpy āntaratamyaparīkṣāyām upayokṣyanta iti bodhyam // kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ / yaralavā antasthāḥ / śaṣasahā ūṣmāṇaḥ / acaḥ svarāḥ / ka pāv iti kapābhyāṃ prāgardhavisargasadṛśau jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyau / aṃ aḥ ity acaḥ parāv anusvāravisargau / iti sthānaprayatnavivekaḥ / ṛḷvarṇayor mithaḥ sāvarṇyaṃ vācyam // akārahakārayor ikāraśakārayor ṛkāraṣakārayor ḷkārasakārayoś ca mithaḥ sāvarṇye prāpte //

SK 13 nājjhalau (A 1.1.10)

ākārasahito 'c āc sa ca hal cety etau mithaḥ savarṇau na staḥ / tena dadhīty asya harati śītalaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sāndram ity eteṣu pareṣu yaṇādikaṃ na / anyathā dīrghādīnām iva hakārādīnām api grahaṇakaśāstrabalād actvaṃ syāt / tathāhi //

SK 14 aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ (A 1.1.69)

pratīyate vidhīyata iti pratyayaḥ / avidhīyamāno 'ṇ udic ca savarṇasya saṃjñā syāt / atrāṇ pareṇa ṇakāreṇa / ku cu ṭu tu pu ete uditaḥ / tad evam / a ity aṣṭādaśānāṃ saṃjñā / tathekārokārau / ṛkāras triṃśataḥ / evaṃ ḷkāro 'pi / eco dvādaśānām / edaitorodautoś ca na mithaḥ sāvarṇyam / aiauj iti sūtrārambhasāmarthyāt / tenaicaścaturviṃśateḥ saṃjñā syur iti nāpādanīyam / nājjhalāv iti niṣedho yady apy ākṣarasamāmnāyikānām evam tathāpi hakārasyākāro na savarṇaḥ / tatrākārasyāpi praśliṣṭatvāt / tena viśvapābhir ity atra ho ḍha iti ḍhatvaṃ na bhavati / anunāsikānanunāsikabhedena  yavalā dvidhā / tenānanunāsikās te dvayor dvayoḥ saṃjñā //

SK 15 taparas tatkālasya (A 1.1.70)

taḥ paro yasmāt sa ca tātparaś coccāryamāṇasamakālasyaiva saṃjñā syāt / tena at it ut ity ādayaḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saṃjñā / ṛd iti dvādaśānām //

SK 16 vṛddhir ādaic (A 1.1.1)

ādaic ca vṛddhisaṃjñaḥ syāt /

SK 17 adeṅ guṇaḥ (A 1.1.2)

adeṅ ca guṇasaṃjñaḥ syāt //

SK 18 bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ (A 1.3.1)

kriyāvācino bhvādayo dhātusaṃjñāḥ syuḥ //

SK 19 pragrīśvarān nipātāḥ (A 1.4.56)

ity adhikṛtya /

SK 20 cādayo 'sattve (A 1.4.57)

adravyārthāś cādayo nipātasaṃjñāḥ syuḥ //

SK 21 prādayaḥ (A 1.4.58)

adravyārthāḥ prādayas tathā //

SK 22 upasargāḥ kriyāyoge (A 1.4.59)

SK 23 gatiś ca (A 1.4.60)

prādayaḥ kriyāyoge upasargasaṃjñā gatisaṃjñāś ca syuḥ / pra parā apa sam anu ava nis nir dus dur vi āṅ ni adhi api ati su ud abhi prati pari upa / ete prādayaḥ //

SK 24 na vetivibhāṣā (A 1.1.44)

niṣedhavikalpayor vibhāṣā saṃjñā syāt //

SK 25 svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā (A 1.1.68)

śabdasya svaṃ rūpaṃ saṃjñi śabdaśāstre yā saṃjñā tāṃ vinā //

SK 26 yena vidhis tadantasya (A 1.1.72)

viśeṣaṇaṃ tadantasya saṃjñā syāt svasya ca rūpasya / samāsapratyayavidhau pratiṣedhaḥ / ugidvarṇagrahaṇavarjam //

SK 27 virāmo 'vasānam (A 1.4.110)

varṇānām abhāvo 'vasānasaṃjñaḥ syāt //

SK 28 paraḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ saṃhitā (A 1.4.109)

varṇānām atiśayitaḥ saṃnidhiḥ saṃhitāsaṃjñaḥ syāt //

SK 29 suptiṅantaṃ padam (A 1.4.14)

subantaṃ tiṅantaṃ ca padasaṃjñaṃ syāt //

SK 30 halo 'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ (A 1.1.7)

ajbhir avyavahitā halaḥ saṃyogasaṃjñāḥ syuḥ //

SK 31 hrasvaṃ laghu (A 1.4.10)

SK 32 saṃyoge guru (A 1.4.11)

saṃyoge pare hrasvaṃ gurusaṃjñaṃ syāt //

SK 33 dīrghaṃ ca //

dīrghaṃ ca gurusaṃjñaṃ syāt //

iti saṃjñāprakaraṇam //

paribhāṣāprakaraṇam 2 //

SK 34 iko guṇavṛddhī (A 1.1.3)

guṇavṛddhiśabdābhyāṃ yatra guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete tatreka iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ padam upatiṣṭhate //

SK 35 acaś ca (A 1.2.28)

hrasvadīrghaplutaśabdair yatrāj vidhīyate tatrāc iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ padam upatiṣṭhate //

SK 36 ādyantau ṭikatau (A 1.1.46)

ṭitkitau yasyoktau tasya kramād ādyantāv avayavau staḥ //

SK 37 mid aco 'ntyāt paraḥ (A 1.1.47)

aca iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭḥī // acāṃ madhye yo 'ntyas tasmāt paras tasyaivāntāvayavo mit syāt //

SK 38 ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā (A 1.1.49)

anirdhāritasaṃbandhaviśeṣā ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā bodhyā / sthānaṃ ca prasaṅgaḥ //

SK 39 sthāne 'ntaratamaḥ (A 1.1.50)

prasaṅge sati sadṛśatama ādeśaḥ syāt / yatrānekavidhamāntaryaṃ tatra sthānata āntaryaṃ balīyaḥ //

SK 40 tasminn iti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya (A 1.1.66)

saptamīnirdeśena vidhīyamānaṃ kāryaṃ varṇāntareṇāvyahitasya pūrvasya bodhyam //

SK 41 tasmād ity uttarasya (A 1.1.67)

pañcamīnirdeśena kriyamāṇaṃ kāryaṃ varṇāntareṇāvyahitasya parasya jñeyam //

SK 42 alo 'ntyasya (A 1.1.52)

ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭāntyasyāla ādeśaḥ syāt //

SK 43 ṅic ca (A 1.1.53)

ayam apy antyasyaiva syāt / -sarvasva- ity asyāpavādaḥ //

SK 44 ādeḥ parasya (A 1.1.54)

parasya yadvihitaṃ tat tasyāder bodhyam / alo 'ntyasya ity asyāpavādaḥ //

SK 45 anekālśit sarvasya (A 1.1.55)

spaṣṭam / alo 'ntyasūtrāpavādaḥ / aṣṭābhya auś ityādau ādeḥ parasya ity etad api paratvād anena bādhyate //

SK 46 svaritenādhikāraḥ (A 1.3.11)

svaritatvayuktaṃ śabdasvarūpam adhikṛtaṃ bodhyam // paranityāntaraṅgāpavādānām uttarottaraṃ balīyaḥ / asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam antaraṅge // akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ // nimittaṃ vināśonmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ na kurvantīty arthaḥ / iti paribhāṣāprakaraṇam //

acsaṃdhiprakaraṇam 3 //

SK 47 iko yaṇ aci (A 6.1.77)

ikaḥ sthāne yaṇ syād aci samhitāyāṃ viṣaye / sudhī upāsya iti sthite / sthānata āntaryād īkārasya yakāraḥ / sudhy upāsya iti jāte //

SK 48 anaci ca (A 8.4.47)

acaḥ parasya yaro dve vā sto na tvaci / iti dhakārasya dvitvam //

SK 49 sthānivadādeśo 'nalvidhau (A 1.1.56)

ādeśaḥ sthānivatsyān na tu sthāny alāśrayavidhau / aneneha yakārasya sthānivadbhāvenāc tvam āśritya anaci ca iti dvitvaniṣedho na śaṅkyo 'nalvidhāv iti tanniṣedhāt //

SK 50 acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau (A 1.1.57)

alvidhyartham idam / paranimitto 'jādeśaḥ sthānivat syāt sthānibhūtād acaḥ pūrvatvena dṛṣṭasya vidhau kartavye / iti sthānivadbhāve prāpte //

SK 51 na padāntadvirvacavareyalopasvarasavarṇānusvāradīrghajaś carvidhiṣu (A 1.1.58)

padasya caramāvayave dvircanādau ca kartavye paranimitto 'jādeśo na sthānivat / dhakārasya dakāraḥ // iti sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhaḥ //

SK 52 jñalāṃ jaśjhaśi (A 8.4.53)

spaṣṭam / iti lopasaṃjñaṃ syāt //

SK 53 adarśanaṃ lopaḥ (A 1.1.60)

prasaktasyādarśanaṃ //

SK 54 saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ (A 8.2.23)

saṃyogāntaṃ yatpadaṃ tadantasya lopasya syāt / iti yalope prāpte // yaṇaḥ pratiṣedho vācyaḥ // yaṇo mayo dve vācye // maya iti pañcamī yaṇa iti ṣaṣṭhīti pakṣe yakārasyāpi dvitvam / tad dhi dhakārayakārayor dvitvavikalpāc catvāri rūpāṇi // ekadham ekayam / dvidhaṃ dviyam / dvidhamekayam / ekadhaṃ dviyam / suddhyupāyaḥ / maddhvariḥ / dhātraṃśaḥ / lākṛtiḥ //

SK 55 nādrinyākrośe putrasya (A 8.4.48)

putraśabdasya na dve sta ādinīśabde pare ākrośe gamyamāne / putrādinī tvam asi ākrośe kim / tattvakathane dvirvacanaṃ bhavaty eva / puttrādinī  sarpiṇī // tatpare ca // putraputrādinī tvam asi pāpe // vā hatajagdhayoḥ // putrahatī / puttrahatī / putrajagdhī / puttrajagdhī //

SK 56 triprabhṛtiṣu śākaṭāyanasya (A 8.4.51)

tryādiṣu varṇeṣu yaṃyukteṣu vā dvitvam / inndraḥ / indraḥ / rāṣṣṭram / rāṣṭram //

SK 57 sarvatra śākalyasya (A 8.4.51)

dvitvaṃ na / arkaḥ / brahmā //

SK 58 dīrghādācāryāṇām (A 8.4.52)

dvitvaṃ na / dātram / pātram /

SK 59 aco rahābhyāṃ dve (A 8.4.46)

acaḥ parābhyāṃ rephahakārābhyāṃ parasya yaro dve vā staḥ / haryyanubhavaḥ / nahyy asti //

SK 60 halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ (A 8.4.64)

halaḥ parasya yamo lopaḥ syād vā yami / iti lopapakṣe dvitvābhāvapakṣe caikayaṃ rūpaṃ tulyam / lopārambhaphalaṃ tu ādityo vedatāsyety ādityaṃ havir ityādau // yamāṃ yamīti yathāsaṃsyavijñānān neha / māhātmyam //

SK 61 eco 'yavāyāvaḥ (A 6.1.78)

ecaḥ kramād ay av āy āv ete syur aci //

SK 62 tasya lopaḥ (A 1.3.9)

tasyeto lopaḥ syāt / iti yavayor lopo na / uccāraṇasāmarthyāt / evaṃ cet saṃjñāpīha na bhavati / haraye / viṣṇave / nāyakaḥ / pāvakaḥ //

SK 63 vānto yi pratyaye (A 6.1.79)

yakārādau pratyaye pare odautor av āv etau staḥ / gor vikāro gavyam / gopayasor yat iti yat / nāvā tāryaṃ nāvyam / nauvayodharma ityādinā yat / gor yūtau chandasy upasaṃkhyānam // adhvaparimāṇe ca // gavyūtiḥ / ūtiyūti ityādinā yūtiśabdo nipātitaḥ / vānta ity atra vakārād gor yūtāv ity atra chakārād vā pūrvabhāge lopo vyorvalīti lopena vakāraḥ praśliṣyate / tena śrūyamāṇavakārānta ādeśaḥ syāt / vakāro na lupyata iti yāvat //

SK 64 dhātos tannimittasyaiva (A 6.1.80)

yādau pratyaye pare dhātor ecaś ced vāntādeśas tarhi tannimittasyaiva nānyasya / lavyam / avaśyalāvyam / tannimittasyaiveti kim / oyate / auyata //

SK 65 kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe (A 6.1.81)

yāntādeśanipātanārtham idam / kṣetuṃ śakyaṃ kṣayyam / jetuṃ śakyaṃ jayyam / śakyārthe kim / kṣetuṃ jetuṃ yogyaṃ kṣeyaṃ pāpaṃ jeyaṃ manaḥ //

SK 66 krayyas tadarthe (A 6.1.82)

tasmai prakṛtyarthāyedaṃ tadartham / kretāraḥ krīṇīyur iti buddhyāāpaṇe prasāritaṃ krayyam / kreyam anyat / krayaṇārham ity arthaḥ //

SK 67 lopaḥ śākalyasya (A 8.3.19)

avarṇapūrvayoḥ padāntayor yavayor vā lopo 'śi pare // pūrvatrāsiddham iti lopaśāstrasyāsiddhatvān na svarasaṃdhiḥ / hara ehi / harayehi / viṣṇa iha / viṣṇāv iha / śriyā udyataḥ / śriyāyudyataḥ / gurā utkaḥ / gurāv utkaḥ // kāni santi kau sta ity atrāsterallopasya sthānivattvena yaṇāvādeśau prāptau napadānteti sūtreṇa padāntavidhau tanniṣedhān na staḥ //

SK 68 ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ (A 6.1.84)

ity adhikṛtya //

SK 69 ād guṇaḥ (A 6.1.87)

avarṇād aci pare pūrvaparayor eko guṇādeśaḥ syāt saṃhitāyām / upendraḥ / rameśaḥ / gaṅgodakam //

SK 70 uraṇ raparaḥ (A 1.1.51)

ṛ iti triṃśataḥ saṃjñety uktam / tatsthāne yo 'ṇ sa raparaḥ sann eva pravartane / tatrāntaratamyāt kṛṣṇarddhir ity atrār / tavaklāra ity atrāl / aco rahābhyām iti pakṣe dvitvam //

SK 71 jharo jhari savarṇe (A 8.4.65)

atikramaṇe pūjāyāṃ cātiḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaḥ syāt / ati devān kṛṣṇaḥ /

SK 557 apiḥ padārthasaṃbhāvanānvavasargagarhāsamuccyaeṣu (A 1.4.96)

eṣu dyotyeṣu apir uktasaṃjñaḥ syāt / sarpiṣo 'pi syāt / anuupasargān na ṣaḥ / saṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ / tasyā eva vipayabhūte bhavane kartṛdaur labhyaprayuktaṃ daurbhyaṃ dyotayann apiśabdaḥ syād ity anena saṃbadhyate / sarpiṣa iti ṣaṣṭhī tu apiśabdabalena gamyamānasya bindor avayavāvayavibhāvasaṃbandhe / iyam eva hy apiśabdasya padārthadyotakatā nāma / dvitīyā tu neha pravartate / sarpiṣo bindunā yogo na tv api nety uktatvāt / api stuyād viṣṇum / saṃbhāvanaṃ śaktyutkarṣam āviṣkartum atyuktiḥ / api stuhi / anvavasargaḥ kāmacārānujñā / dhig devadattam api stuyād vṛṣalam / garhā / api siñca api stuhi / samuccaye /

SK 558 kālādhvanor atyantasaṃyoge (A 2.3.5)

iha dvitīyā syāt / māsaṃ kalyāṇī / māsam adhīte / māsaṃ guḍadhānāḥ / krośaṃ kuṭilā nadī / krośam adhīte / krośaṃ giriḥ / atyantasaṃyoge kim / māsasya dvir adhīte / krośasyaikadeśe parvata / iti dvitīyā //

SK 559 svatantraḥ kartā (A 1.4.54)

kriyāyāṃ svātantryeṇa vivakṣito 'rthaḥ kartā syāt /

SK 560 sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam (A 1.4.42)

kriyāsiddhau prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ karaṇasaṃjñaṃ syāt / tamapgrahaṇaṃ kim / gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ /

SK 561 kartṛkaraṇayos tṛtīyā (A 2.3.18)

anabhihite kartari karaṇe ca tṛtīyā syāt / rāmeṇa bāṇena hato vālī / prakṛtyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam / prakṛtyā cāruḥ / prāyeṇa yājñikaḥ / gotreṇa gārgyaḥ / samenaiti / viṣamaiṇeti / dvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti / sukhena duḥkhena vā yātītyādi /

SK 562 divaḥ karma ca (A 1.4.43)

divaḥ sādhakatamaṃ kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ syāc cāt karaṇasaṃjñam / akṣair akṣānvā dīvyati /

SK 563 apavarge tṛtīyā (A 1.4.43)

apavargaḥ phalaprāptis tasyāṃ syotyāyāṃ kālādhvanor atyantasaṃyoge tṛtīyā syāt / ahnā krośena vānuvāko 'dhītaḥ / apavarge kim / māsam adhīto nāyātaḥ /

SK 564 sahayuktte 'pradhāne (A 2.3.19)

sahārthena yukte apradhne tṛtīyā syāt / putreṇa sahāgataḥ pitā / evaṃ sākaṃsārdhaṃsamaṃyoge 'pi / vināpi tadyogaṃ tṛtīyā / vṛddho yunā ityādinirśesāt /

SK 565 yenāṅgavikāraḥ (A 2.3.20)

yenāṅgena vikṛtenāṅgino vikāro lakṣyate tatas tṛtīyā syāt / akṣṇā kāṇaḥ / akṣisaṃbandhikāṇatvaviśiṣṭa ity arthaḥ / aṅgavikāraḥ kim / akṣi kāṇam asya /

SK 566 itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe (A 2.3.21)

kaṃcitprakāraṃ prāptasya lakṣaṇe tṛtīyā syāt / jaṭābhis tāpasaḥ / jaṭājñāpyatāpasatvaviśiṣṭa ity arthaḥ /

SK 567 saṃjño 'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi (A 2.3.22)

saṃpūrvasya jānāteḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā vā syāt / pitrā pitaraṃ vā saṃjānīte /

SK 568 hetau (A 2.3.23)

hetvarthe tṛtīyā syāt / dravyādisādhāraṇaṃ nirvyāpārasādhāraṇaṃ ca hetutvam / karaṇatvaṃ tu kriyāmātraviṣayaṃ vyāpāraniyataṃ ca / karaṇatvaṃ tu kriyāmātraviṣayaṃ vyāpāraniyataṃ ca / daṇḍena ghaṭaḥ / puṇyena dṛṣṭo hariḥ / phalam apīha hetuḥ / adhyayanena vasati / gamyamānāpi kriyā kārakavibhaktau prayojikā / alaṃ krameṇa sādhyaṃ nāstīty arthaḥ / sādhanakriyāṃ prati śramaḥ karaṇam / śatenaśatena vatsān pāyayati payaḥ / śatena paricchidyety arthaḥ / aśiṣṭavyavahāre dāṇaḥ prayoge caturthyarthe tṛtīyā / dāsyā saṃyacchate kāmukaḥ / dharme tu bhāryāyai saṃyacchati / iti tṛtīyā /

SK 569 karmaṇā yam abhipraiti sa saṃpradānam (A 1.4.32)

dānasya karmaṇā yam abhipraiti sa saṃpradānasaṃjñaḥ / syāt /

SK 570 caturthī saṃpradāne (A 2.3.13)

viprāya gāṃ dadāti / anabhihita ity eva / dānīyo vipraḥ / kriyayā yam abhipraiti so 'pi saṃpradānam / patye śete / yajeḥ karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñā saṃpradānasya ca karmasaṃjñā / paśunā rudraṃ yajate / paśuṃ rudrāya dadātīty arthaḥ /

SK 571 rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ (A 1.4.33)

rucyarthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ prayoge prīyamāṇo 'rthaḥ saṃpradānaṃ syāt / haraye rocate bhaktiḥ / anyakartṛko 'bhilāṣo ruciḥ / hariinṣṭhaprīter bhaktiḥ kartrī / prīyamānaḥ kim / devadattāya rocate modakaḥ pathi /

SK 572 ślāghahnuṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ (A 1.4.34)

eṣāṃ prayoge bodhayitum iṣṭaḥ saṃpradānaṃ syāt / gopī smarāt kṛṣṇāya ślāghate hnute tiṣṭhate śapate vā / jñīpsyamānaḥ kim / devadattāya ślāghate pathi /

SK 573 dhārer uttamarṇaḥ (A 1.4.35)

dhārayateḥ prayoge uttamarṇaḥ uktasaṃjñaḥ syāt / bhaktāya dhārayati mokṣaṃ hariḥ / uttamarṇaḥ kim / devadattāya śataṃ dhārayati grāme /

SK 574 spṛher īpsitaḥ (A 1.4.36)

spṛhayateḥ prayoge iṣṭaḥ saṃpradānaṃ syāt / puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati īpsitaḥ kim / puṣpebhyo vane spṛhayati / īpsitamātre iyaṃ saṃjñā / prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ tu paratvāt karmasaṃjñā / puṣpāṇi spṛhayati /

SK 575 krudhadruherṣyāsūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ (A 1.4.37)

krudhādyarthānāṃ prayoge yaṃ prati kopaḥ sa uktasaṃjñaḥ syāt / haraye krudhyati / druhyati / īrṣyati / asūyati / yaṃ prati kopaḥ kim / bhāryām īrṣyati maināmanyo 'drākṣīd iti / krodho 'marṣaḥ / droho 'pakāraḥ / īrṣyākṣayā / asūyā guṇeṣu doṣāviṣkaraṇam / druhādayo 'pi kopaprabhavā eva gṛhyante ato viśeṣaṇam sāmānyena yaṃ prati kopa iti /

SK 576 krudhadruhor upasṛṣṭayoḥ karma (A 1.4.38)

sopasargayor anayor yaṃ prati kopas tatkārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ syāt / krūram abhikrudhyati / asidruhyati /

SK 577 rādhīkṣyor yasya vipraśnaḥ (A 1.4.39)

etayoḥ kārakaṃ saṃpradānaṃ syāt / yadīyo vividhaḥ praśnaḥ kriyate / kṛṣṇāya rādhyati īkṣate vā / pṛṣṭo gargaḥ śubhaśubhaṃ paryālocayatīty arthaḥ /

SK 578 pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā (A 1.4.40)

ābhyāṃ parasya śṛṇoter yoge pūrvasya pravartanarūpavyāpārasya kartā saṃpradānaṃ syāt / viprāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇoti āśṛṇeti vā / vipreṇa mahyaṃ dehīti pravartitaḥ pratijānīta ity arthaḥ /

SK 579 anupratigṛnaś ca (A 1.4.41)

ābhyāṃ gṛṇāteḥ kārakaṃ pūrvavyāpārasya kartṛbhūtamuktasaṃjñaṃ syāt / hotre 'nugṛṇāti pratigṛṇāti/ hotā prathamaṃ śaṃsati tam adhvaryuḥ protsāhatīty arthaḥ /

SK 580 parikrayaṇe saṃpradānam anyatarasyām (A 1.4.44)

niyatakālaṃ bhṛtyā svīkaraṇaṃ parikrayaṇaṃ tasmin sādhakatamaṃ kārakaṃ saṃpradānasaṃjñaṃ vā syāt / śatena śatāya vā parikrītiḥ / tādarthye caturthī vācyā / muktaye hariṃ bhajati / kḷpi saṃpadyamāne ca / bhaktir jñānāya kalpate saṃpadyate jāyata ityādi / utpātena jñāpite ca / vātāya kapilā vidyut / hitayoge ca / brāhmaṇāya hitam /

SK 581 kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ (A 2.3.14)

kriyārthā kriyā upapadaṃ yasya tasya sthānino 'prayujyamānasya tumunaḥ karmaṇi caturthī syāt / phalebhyo yāti / ohalāny āhartuṃ yātīty arthaḥ / namaskurmo nṛsiṃhāya / nṛsiṃham anukūlayitum ity arthaḥ / evaṃ svayaṃbhuve namaskṛtyetyādāv api /

SK 582 tumarthāc ca bhāvavacanāt (A 2.3.15)

vihitas tadantāc caturthī syāt / yāgāya yāti / yuṣṭuṃ yātīty arthaḥ /

SK 583 namaḥsvastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍyogāc ca (A 2.3.16)

ebhir yoge caturthī syāt / haraye namaḥ / upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktir balīyasī / namaskaroti devān / prajābhyaḥ svasti / agnaye svāhā / pitṛbhyaḥ svādhā / alam iti paryāptyarthagrahaṇam / tena daityebhyo harir alaṃ prabhuḥ samarthaḥ śakta ityādi / prabhvādiyoge ṣaṣṭhy api sādhuḥ / tasmai prabhavati sa eṣāṃ grāmaṇīḥ iti nirdeśāt / tena prabhur bubhūṣur bhuvanatrayasyeti siddham / vaṣaḍindrāya / cakāraḥ punar vidhānārthaḥ / tenāśīrvivakṣāyāṃ parām api caturthī cāśiṣīti ṣaṣṭhīṃ bādhitvā caturthy eva bhavati / svasti gobhyo bhūyāt /

SK 584 manyakarmaṇy anādare vibhāṣāprāṇiṣu (A 2.3.17)

prāṇivarje manyateḥ karmaṇi caturthī vā syāt tiraskāre / na tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manye tṛṇāya vā / śyanā nirdeśāt tānādikayoge na / na tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manve 'ham / aprāṇiṣv ity apanīya / naukākānnaśukaśṛgālavarjyeṣv iti vācyam / tena na tvāṃ nāvam annaṃ vā manye ity atrāprāṇitve 'pi caturthī na / na tvāṃ śune manye ity atra prāṇitve 'pi bhavaty eva /

SK 585 gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturhtyau ceṣṭāyām anadhvan (A 2.3.12)

adhvabhinne gatyarthānāṃ karmaṇi ete staśceṣṭāyām / grāmaṃ grāmāya vā gacchati / ceṣṭāyāṃ kim / manasā hariṃ vrajati / anadhvanīti kim / panthānaṃ gacchati / gāntrādhiṣhite 'dhvanyevāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ / yadā tūtpathāt panthā evākramitum iṣyate tadā caturthī bhavaty eva / utpathena pathe gacchati / iti caturthī /

SK 586 dhruvam apāye 'pādānam (A 1.4.24)

apāyo viśleṣas tasmin sādhye dhruvam avadhibhūtaṃ kārakam apādānaṃ syāt /

SK 587 apādāne pañcamī (A 2.3.28)

grāmād āyāti / dhāvato 'śvāt patati / kārakaṃ kim / vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati / jugupsāvvirāmapramādārthānām upasaṃkhyānam / pāpāj jugupsate / viramati / dharmāt pramādyati /

SK 588 bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ (A 1.4.25)

bhayārhtānāṃ trāṇārthānāṃ ca prayoge bhayahetur apādānaṃ syāt / corād bibheti / corāt trāyate / bhayahetuḥ kim / araṇye vibheti trāyateti vā /

SK 589 parājer asoḍhaḥ (A 1.4.26)

parājeḥ prayoge 'sahyo 'rtho 'pādānaṃ syāt / adhyayanāt parājayate / glāyatīty arthaḥ / asoḍhaḥ kim / śatrūn parājayate / abhibhavatīty arthaḥ /

SK 590 vāraṇārthānām īpsitaḥ (A 1.4.27)

pravṛttivighāto vāraṇam / vāranārthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ prayoge īpsito 'pādānaṃ syāt / yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati / īpsitaḥ kim / yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati kṣetre /

SK 591 antardhau yenādarśanam icchati (A 1.4.28)

vyavadhāne sati yat kartṛkasyātmano darśanasyābhāvam icchati tadapādānaṃ syāt / mātur nilīyate kṛṣṇaḥ / antardhau kim / caurān na didṛkṣate / icchatigrahaṇam kim / adarśanecchāyāṃ satyāṃ saty api daśane yathā syāt /

SK 592 ākhyātopayoge (A 1.4.29)

niyamapūrvakavidyāsvīkāre vaktā prāksaṃjñaḥ syāt / upādhyāyād adhīte / upayoge kim / naṭasya gāthāṃ śṛṇoti /

SK 593 janikartuḥ (A 1.4.30)

jāyamānasya hetur apādānaṃ syāt / brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante /

SK 594 bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ (A 1.4.31)

bhuvanaṃ bhūḥ / bhūkartuḥ prabhavas tathā / himavato gaṅgā prabhavati / tatra prakāśata ity arthaḥ / lyablope karmaṇy adhikaraṇe ca / prāsādāt prakṣate / āsanāt prekṣate / prāsādam āruhya āsane upaviśya prekṣata ity arthaḥ / śvaśurāj jihreti / śvaśuraṃ vīkṣyety arthaḥ / gāmyamānāpi kriyā kārakavibhaktīnāṃ nimittam / kasmāt tvaṃ nadyāḥ / yataś cādhvakālanirmāṇaṃ tatra pañcamī / tadyuktād adhvanaḥ prathamāsaptamyau / kālāt saptamī ca vaktvyā / vanād grāmo yojanaṃ yojane vā / kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇī māse /

SK 595 anyārāditararte dkśabdāñcūttarapadājāhiyukte (A 2.3.29)

etair yoge pañcamī syāt / anya ity arthagrahaṇam / itaragrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham / anyo bhinna itaro vā kṛṣṇāt / ārād vanāt / ṛte kṛṣṇāt / pūrvo grāmāt / diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabdaḥ / tena saṃprati deśakālavṛttinā yoge 'pi bhavati / caitrāt pūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ / avayavavāciyoge tu na / tasya param āmreḍitam iti nirdeśāt / pūrvaṃ kāyasya / añcūttarapadasya tu dikśabdatve 'pi ṣaṣṭhyatasartha iti ṣaṣṭhīṃ bādhituṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam / prāk pratyag vā grāmāt / āc dakṣiṇā grāmāt / āhi dakṣiṇāhi grāmāt / apādāne pañcamī iti sūtre kārtikyāḥ prabhṛtīti bhāṣyaprayogāt prabhṛtyarthayoge pañcamī bhavāt prabhṛti ārabhya vā sevyo hariḥ / apaparībahiḥ iti samāsavidhānāj jñāpakād bahiryoge pañcamī / grāmād bahiḥ /

SK 596 apaparī varjane (A 1.4.88)

etau varjane karmapravacanīyau staḥ /

SK 597 āṅ maryādāvacane (A 1.4.89)

āṅ maryādāyām uktasaṃjñaḥ syāt / vacanagrahaṇād abhividhāv api /

SK 598 pañcamy apāṅparibhiḥ (A 1.4.90)

etaiḥ karmapravacanīyair yoge pañcamī syāt / apa hareḥ pari hareḥ saṃsāraḥ / parir atra varjane / lakṣaṇādau tu hariṃ pari / ām ukteḥ saṃsāraḥ / āsakalād brahma /

SK 599 pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ (A 1.4.92)

etayor artayoḥ pratir uktasaṃjñaḥ syāt /

SK 600 pratinidhipratidāne ca yasyāt (A 2.3.11)

atra karmapravacanīyair yoge pañcamī syāt / pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇāt prati / tilebhyaḥ pratiyacchati māṣān /

SK 601 akartary ṛṇe pañcamī (A 2.3.24)

kartṛvarjitaṃ yad ṛṇaṃ hetubhūtaṃ tataḥ pañcamī syāt / śatād baddhaḥ / akartari kim / śatena bandhitaḥ /

SK 602 vibhāṣā guṇe 'striyām (A 2.3.25)

guṇe hetāv astrīliṅge pañcamī vā syāt / jāḍyāj jāḍyena vā baddhaḥ / guṇe kim / dhanena kulam / astriyāṃ kim / baddhyā muktaḥ / vibhāṣeti yogavibhāgād aguṇe striyāṃ ca kvacit / dhūmād agimān / nāsti ghaṭo 'nupalabdheḥ /

SK 603 pṛthagvinānānābhis tṛtīyānyatarasyām (A 2.3.32)

ebhir yoge tṛtīyā syāt pañcamīdvitīye ca / anyatarasyāṃgahaṇaṃ samuccayārtham / pañcamīdvitīye 'nuvartete / pṛthag rāmeṇa rāmāt rāmaṃ vā / evaṃ vinā nānā /

SK 604 kareṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyāsattvavacanasya (A 2.3.33)

ebhyo 'dravyavacanebhyaḥ karaṇe tṛtīyāpañcamyau staḥ / stokena stokād vā muktaḥ / dravye tu stokena viṣeṇa hataḥ /

SK 605 dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca (A 2.3.35)

ebhyo dvitīyā syāc cāt pañcamītṛtīye / prātipadikārthamātre vidhir ayam / grāmasya dūraṃ dūrāt dūreṇa vā / antikam antikāt antikena vā / asattvavacanasyety anuvṛtter neha / dūraḥ panthāḥ iti pañcamī /

SK 606 ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe (A 2.3.50)

kārakaprātipadokārthavyatiriktaḥ svasvāmibhāvādisaṃbandhaḥ śeṣas tatra ṣaṣṭhī syāt / rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ / karmādīnām api saṃbandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhy eva / satāṃ gatam / sarpiṣo jānīte / mātuḥ smarati / edho dakasyopaskurute / bhaje śaṃbhoś caraṇayoḥ / phalānāṃ tṛptaḥ /

SK 607 ṣaṣṭḥī hetuprayoge (A 2.3.26)

hetuśabdaprayoge hetau dyotye ṣaṣṭhī syāt / annasya hetor vsati /

SK 608 sarvanāmnas tṛtīyā ca (A 2.3.27)

sarvanāmno hetuśabdasya ca prayoge hetau dyotye tṛtīyā syāt ṣaṣṭhī ca / kena hetunā vasati / kasya hetiḥ / nimittaparyāyaprayoge sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam / kiṃ nimittaṃ vasati / kena nimittena / kasmai minittāyetyādi / evaṃ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ko 'hetuḥ kiṃ prayojanam ityādi / prāyagrahaṇād asarvanāmnaḥ prathamādvitīye na staḥ / jñānena nimittena hariḥ sevyaḥ / jñānāya nimittāyetyādi /

SK 609 ṣaṣṭhy atasarthapratyayena (A 2.3.30)

etadyoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt / dikśabda iti pañcamyā apavdaḥ / grāmasya dakṣiṇataḥ / puraḥ purastāt / upari upariṣṭāt /

SK 610 enapā dvitīyā (A 2.3.31)

enabantena yoge dvitīyā syāt / enapeti ygavibhāgāt ṣaṣṭhy api / dakṣiṇena grāmaṃ grāmasya vā / evam uttareṇa /

SK 611 dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhy anyatarasyām (A 2.3.34)

etair yoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt pañcamī ca / dūraṃ nikaṭaṃ grāmasya grāmād vā /

SK 612 jño 'vidarthasya karaṇe (A 2.3.51)

jānāter ajñānārthasya karaṇe śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhī syāt / sarpiṣo jñānam /

SK 613 adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi (A 2.3.52)

eṣāṃ karmaṇi śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt / mātuḥ smaraṇam / sarpiṣo dayanam īśanaṃ vā /

SK 614 kṛñaḥ pratiyatne (A 2.3.53)

kṛñaḥ karmaṇi śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī syād guṇādhāne / edho dakasyopaskaraṇam /

SK 615 rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānām ajvareḥ (A 2.3.54)

bhāvakartṛkāṇāṃ jvarivarjitānāṃ rujārthānāṃ karmaṇi śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt / caurasya rogasya rujā / ajvarisaṃtāpyor iti vācyam / rogasya caurajvaraḥ caurasaṃtāpo vā / rogakartṛkaṃ caurasaṃbandhi jvarādikam ity arthaḥ /

SK 616 āśiṣi nāthaḥ (A 2.3.55)

āśīrarthasya nāthateḥ śeṣe karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt / sarpiṣo nāthanam / āśiṣīti kim / māṇavakanāthanam / tatsaṃbandhinī yācñety arthaḥ /

SK 617 jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām (A 2.3.56)

hiṃsārthānām eṣāṃ śeṣe karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt / caurasyojjāsanam / niprau saṃhatau viparyastau vystau vā / caurasya niprahaṇanam / praṇihananam / nihananam / prahaṇanaṃ vā / naṭa avaskandane curādiḥ / caurasyonnāṭanam / caurasya krāthanam / vṛṣalasya peṣaṇam / hiṃsāyāṃ kim / dhānāpeṣaṇam /

SK 618 vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ (A 2.3.57)

śeṣe karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt / dyūte krayavikrayavyavahāre cānayos tulyārthatā / śatasya vyavaharaṇaṃ paṇanaṃ vā / samarthayoḥ kim / śalākāvyavahāraḥ / gaṇanety arthaḥ / brāhmaṇapaṇamaṁ stutir ity arthaḥ /

SK 619 divas tadarthasya (A 2.3.58)

dyūtārthasya krayavikrayarūpavyavahārārthasya ca divaḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt / śatasya dīvyati tadarthasya kim / brāhmaṇaṃ dīvyati / stautīty arthaḥ /

SK 620 vibhāṣopasarge (A 2.3.59)

pūrvayogāpavādaḥ / śatasya śataṃ vā pratidīvyati /

SK 621 preṣyabruvor haviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne (A 2.3.61)

devatāsaṃpradāne 'rthe vartamānayoḥ preṣyabruvoḥ karmaṇo havirviśeṣasya vācakāc chabdāt śaṣṭhī syāt / agnaye chāgasya haviṣo vapāyā medasa preṣya anubrūhi vā /

SK 622 kṛtvorthaprayoge kāle 'dhikaraṇe (A 2.3.64)

kṛtvorthānāṃ prayoge kālavāciny adhikaraṇe śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt / pañcakṛtvo 'hno bhojanam / dvirahno bhojanam / śeṣe kim / dvirahany adhyayanam /

SK 623 kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti (A 2.3.65)

kṛdyoge kartari karmaṇi ca ṣaṣṭhī syāt / kṛṣṇasya kṛtiḥ / jagataḥ kartā kṛṣṇaḥ / guṇakarmaṇi ceṣyate / netā 'śvasya srughnasya srughnaṃ vā / kṛti kim / taddhite mā bhūt / kṛtapūrvī kaṭam /

SK 624 upayaprāptau karmaṇi (A 2.3.66)

ubhayoḥ prāptir yasmin kṛti tatra karmaṇy eva ṣaṣṭhī syāt / āścaryo gavāṃ doho 'gopena / strīpratyayayor akākārayor nāyaṃ niyamaḥ / bhedikā bibhitsā vā rudrasya jagataḥ / śeṣe vibhāṣā / strīpratyaya ity eke / vicitrā jagataḥ / kṛtir harer hariṇā vā / kecid aviśeṣeṇa vibhāṣām icchanti / śabdānām anuśāsanam ācaryeṇācāryasya vā /

SK 625 ktasya ca vartamāne (A 2.3.67)

vartamānārthasya ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt / na loka–iti niṣedhasyāpavādaḥ / rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā /

SK 626 adhikaraṇavācinaś ca (A 2.3.68)

ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt / idam eṣām āsitaṃ śayitaṃ gataṃ bhuktaṃ vā /

SK 627 na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām (A 2.3.69)

eṣāṃ prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na syāt / lādeśaḥ / kurvan kurvāṇo vā sṛṣṭiṃ hariḥ / uḥ / hariṃ didṛkṣuḥ / alaṃkariṣṇur vā / uka / daityān ghātuko hariḥ / kamer aniṣedhaḥ / lakṣmyāḥ kāmuko hariḥ / avyayam / jagat sṛṣṭvā / sukhaṃ kartum / niṣṭhā / viṣṇunā hatā daityāḥ / daityān hatavān viṣṇuḥ / khalarthaḥ / īṣatkaraḥ prapañco hariṇā / tṛnn iti pratyāhāraḥ śatṛśānacāv iti tṛśabdād ārabhyā tṛno nakārāt / śanan / somaṃ pavamānaḥ / cānaś / ātmanaṃ maṇḍayamānaḥ / śatṛ / vedam adhīyan / tṛn / kartā lokān / dviṣaḥ śatur vā / murasya muraṃ vā dviṣan / sarvo 'yaṃ kārakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ / śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī tu syād eva / brāhmaṇasya kurvan / narakasya jiṣṇuḥ /

SK 628 akenor bhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ (A 2.3.70)

bhaviṣyaty akasya bhaviṣyadādhamarṇyārthenaś ca yoge ṣaṣṭhī na syāt / sataḥ pālako 'vatarati / vrajaṃ gāmī / śataṃ dāyī /

SK 629 kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā (A 2.3.71)

ṣaṣṭhī vā syāt / mayā mama vā sevyo hariḥ / kartarīti kim / geyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnām / bhavyageya---iti kartari yadvidhānād anabhihitaṃ karma / atra yogo vibhajyate / kṛtyānām / ubhayaprāptāv iti neti cānuvartate / tena netavyā vrajaṃ gāvaḥ kṛṣṇena / tataḥ / kartari vā / ukto 'rthaḥ /

SK 630 tulyārthair atulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyāntarasyām (A 2.3.72)

tulyārthair yoge tṛtīyā vāsyāt pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī / tulyaḥ sadṛśaḥ samo vā kṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇena vā / atulopamābhyāṃ kim / tulā upamā vā kṛṣṇasya nāsti /

SK 631 caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaih (A 2.3.73)

etadarthair yoge catuthā  vā syāt pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī āśiṣi / āyuṣyaṃ ciraṃjīvitaṃ kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇasya vā bhūyāt / evaṃ madraṃ bhadraṃ kuśalaṃ nirāmayaṃ sukhaṃ śaṃ arthaḥ prayojanaṃ hitaṃ pathyaṃ vā bhūyāt / āśiṣi kim / devadattasyāyuṣyam asti / vyākhyānāt sarvatrārthagrahaṇam / madrabhadrayoḥ paryāyatvād anyataro na paṭhanīyaḥ / iti ṣaṣṭhī /

SK 632 ādhāro 'dhikaraṇam (A 1.4.45)

kartṛkarmadvārā tanniṣṭhakriyāyā ādhāraḥ kārakam adhikaraṇasaṃjñaḥ syāt /

SK 633 saptamy adhikaraṇe ca (A 2.3.36)

adhikaraṇe saptamī syāt / cakārā rāntikārthebhyaḥ / aupaśleṣiko vaiṣayiko 'bhivyāpakas cety ādhāras tridhā / kaṭe āste / sthālyāṃ pacati / mokṣe icchāsti / sarvasminnatātmāsti / vanasya dūre antike vā / dūrāntikārthebhyaḥ iti vibhaktitrayeṇa saha catasro 'tra vibhaktayaḥ phalitā / ktasyenviṣayasya krmaṇy upasaṃkhyānam / adhītī vyākaraṇe / adhītam aneneti vigrahe iṣṭādibhyaś ca iti kartarīnaḥ / sādhvasādhuprayoge ca / sādhuḥ kṛṣṇo mātari / asādhur mātule / nimittāt karmayoge nimittam iha phalam / yogaḥ saṃyogasamavāyātmakaḥ / carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti dantayor hanti kuñjaram / keśeṣu camarīṃ hanti sīmni puṣkalako hataḥ / (iti bhāṣyaṃ) / hetau tṛtīyātra prāptā tannivāraṇārtham idam / sīmāṇḍakośaḥ / puṣkalako gandhamṛgaḥ / yogaviśeṣe kim / vetanena dhānyaṃ lunāti /

SK 634 yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam (A 2.3.37)

yasya kriyayā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣyate tataḥ saptamī syāt / goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ / arhāṇāṃ kartṛtve 'narhāṇām akartṛtve tadvaiparītye ca / satsu taratsu asanta āsate / asatsu tiṣṭhatsu santas taranti / satsu tiṣṭatsu asantas taranti / asatsu taratsy santas tiṣṭhanti /

SK 635 ṣaṣṭhī cānādare (A 2.3.38)

anādarādhikye bhāvalakṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau staḥ / rudati rudato vā prāvrājīt / rudantaṃ putrādikam anādṛtya saṃyastavān ity arthaḥ /

SK 636 svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiś ca (A 2.3.39)

etaiḥ saptabhir yoge ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau staḥ / ṣaṣṭhyām eva prāptāyāṃ pākṣikasaptamyarthaṃ vacanam / gavāṃ goṣu vā svāmī / gavāṃ goṣu vā prasūtaḥ / gā evānubhavituṃ jāta ity arthaḥ /

SK 637 āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām (A 2.3.40)

ābhyāṃ yoge ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau stas tātparye 'rthe / āyukto vyāpāritaḥ / āyuktaḥ kuśalo vā haripūjane haripūjanasya vā / āsevāyāṃ kim / āyukto gauḥ śakaṭe / īṣadyukta ity arthaḥ /

SK 638 yataś ca nirdhāraṇam (A 2.3.41)

jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñābhiḥ samudāyād ekadeśasya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ nirdhāraṇaṃ yatas tataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau staḥ / nṛṇāṃ nṛṣu vābrāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ / gavāṃ goṣu vā kṛṣṇā bahukṣīrā / gacchatāṃ gacchatsu vā dhāvan śīghraḥ / chātrāṇāṃ chātreṣu vā maitraḥ paṭuḥ /

SK 639 pañcamī vibhakte (A 2.3.42)

vibhāgo vibhaktam / nirdhāryamāṇasya yatra bheda eva tatra pañcamī syāt / māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍyatarāḥ /

SK 640 sādhunipuṇābhyām arcāyāṃ saptamy aprateḥ (A 2.3.43)

ābhyāṃ yoge sapatamī syād arcāyāṃ na tu prateḥ prayoge / mātari sādhunipuṇo vā / arcāyāṃ kim / nipṇo rājño bhṛtyaḥ / iha tattvakathane tātpartam / apratyādibhir iti vaktavyam / sādhur nipuṇo vā mātaraṃ prati pary anu vā /

SK 641 prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca (A 2.3.44)

ābhyāṃ yoge tṛtīyā syāc cāt sapatamī / prasita utsuko vā hariṇā harau vā /

SK 642 nakṣatre ca lupi (A 2.3.45)

nakṣatre prakṛtyarthe yo lupsaṃjñayā sto 'dhikaraṇe / mūlenāvāhayed devīṃ śravaṇena visarjayet / mūle śravaṇe iti vā / lupi kim / puṣye śaniḥ /

SK 643 saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye (A 2.3.7)

śaktidvayamadhye yau kālādhvānau tābhyām ete staḥ / adya bhuktvāyaṃ dvyahe dvyahād vā bhoktā / jartṛśaktyor madhye 'yaṃ kālaḥ / ihastho 'yaṃ krośe krośād vālakṣyaṃ vidhyet / kartṛkarmaśaktyor madhye 'yaṃ deśaḥ / adhikaśabdena yoge saptamīpañcamyāv iṣyete / tadasminnadhikam iti yasmād adhikam iti ca sūtranirdeśāt / loke lokād bādhiko hariḥ /

SK 644 adhir īśvare (A 1.4.97)

svasvāmibhāvasaṃbandhe 'dhiḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaḥ syāt /

SK 645 yasmād adhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī (A 2.3.9)

atra karmapravacanīyayukte saptamī syāt / upa parārdhe harer guṇāḥ / parārdhād adhikā ity arthaḥ / aiśvarye tu svasvāmibhyāṃ paryāyeṇa saptamī / adhi bhuvi rāmaḥ / adhi rāme bhūḥ / saptamī śauṇḍar iti samāsapakṣe tu rāmādhīnā / aṣaḍakṣa–ityādinā khaḥ /

SK 646 vibhāṣā kṛñi (A 1.4.98)

adhiḥ karotau prāksaṃjño vā syād īśvare 'rthe / yad atra mām adhikariṣyati / viniyokṣyata ity arthaḥ / iha viniyoktur īśvaratvaṃ gamyate / agatitvāt tiṅi codāttavati–iti nighāto na / iti saptamī //

iti kārakaprakaraṇam /

avyayībhāvaprakaraṇam 17 //

SK 647  samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ (A 2.11)

padasaṃbandhī yo vidhiḥ sa samarthāśrito bodhyaḥ /

SK 648 prākkaḍārāt samāsaḥ (A 2.1.3)

kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye ity ataḥ prāk samāsa ity adhikriyate /

SK 649 saha supā (A 2.1.4)

saha iti yogo vibhajyate / subantaṃ samarthena saha samasyate / yogavibhāgasyeṣṭasiddhyarthatvāt katipayatiṅantottarapado 'yaṃ samāsaḥ / sa ca chandasy eva / paryabhūṣat / anuvyacalat / supā sup supā saha samasyate / samāsatvāt prātipadikatvam //

SK 650 supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ (A 2.3.71)

etayor avayavasya supo luk syāt / bhūtapūrve caraṭ iti nirdeśād bhūtaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ / pūrvaṃ bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ / ivena samāso vibhaktyalopaś ca jīmūtasyeva //

SK 651 avyayībhāvaḥ (A 2.1.5)

adhikāro 'yam /

SK 652 avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpasamṛddhivyṛddhyarthābhāvātyayāsaṃpratiśabdaprādurbhāvapaścādyathānupūrvyayaugapadyasādṛśyasaṃpattisākalyāntavacanaṣu (A 2.1.6)

avyayam iti yogo vibhajyate / avyayaṃ samarthena saha samasyate so 'vyayībhāvaḥ /

SK 653 prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam (A 1.2.43)

samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭam upasarjanasaṃjñaṃ syāt /

SK 654 upasarjanaṃ pūrvam (A 2.2.30)

samāse upasarjanaṃ prākprayojyam /

SK 655 ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte (A1.2.44)

vigrahe yanniyatavibhaktikaṃ tadupasarjanasaṃjñaṃ syāt na tu tasya pūrvanipātaḥ //

SK 656 gostriyor upasarjanasya (A 1.2.48)

upasarjanaṃ yo gośabdaḥ strīpratyayāntaṃ ca tadantasya prātipadikasya hrasvaḥ syāt / avyayībhāvaś ca ity avyayatvam /

SK 657 nāvyayībhāvād ato 'm tv apañcamyāḥ (A 2.4.83)

adantād avyayībhāvāt supo na luk kiṃtu tasya pañcamīṃ vinā amādeśaḥ / diśayor madhye apadiśam / klībāvyayaṃ tv apadiśaṃ diśor madhye vidikstriyām ity amaraḥ /

SK 658 tṛtīyāsaptamyor bahulam (A 2.4.84)

adantād avyayībhāvāt tṛtīyāsaptamyor bahulam ambhāvaḥ syāt / apadiśam / apadiśena / apadiśam / apadiśe / bahulagrahaṇāt sumadram unmattagaṅgam ityādau saptamyā nityam ambhāvaḥ / vibhaktītyāder ayam arthaḥ / vibhaktyarthādiṣu vartamānam avyayaṃ subantena saha samasyate so 'vyayībhāvaḥ / vibhaktau tāvat / harau ity adhihari / saptamyarthasyaivātra dyotako 'dhiḥ / hari ṅi adhi ity laukikaṃ vigrahavākyam / atra nipātenābhihite 'py adhikaraṇe vacanasāmarthyāt saptamī /

SK 659 avyayībhāvaś ca (A 2.4.18)

ayaṃ napuṃsakaṃ syāt / hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya / gopāyatīti gāḥ pātīti vā gopāḥ / tasminn ity adhigopam / samīpe / kṛṣṇasya samīpam upakṛṣṇam / samayā grāmam nikaṣā laṅkām, ārād vanād ity atra tu nāvyayībhāvaḥ / abhitaḥ paritaḥ anyārāt iti dvitīyāpañcamyor vidhānasāmarthyāt / madrāṇāṃ samṛddhiḥ sumadram / yavanānāṃ vyṛddhir duryavanam / vigatā ṛddhivyṛddhiḥ / makṣikāṇām abhāvo nirmakṣikam / himasyātyayo 'tihimam / atyayo dhvaṃsaḥ / nidrā saṃprati na yujyata ity atinidram / hariśabdasya prakāśa itihari / viṣṇoḥ paścād anuviṣṇu / paścācchabdasya tu nāyaṃ samāsaḥ / tataḥ paścāt sraṃsyate iti bhāṣyaprayogāt / yogyatāvīpsāpadārthān ativṛttisādṛśyāni yathārthāḥ / anurūpam / rūpasya ygyam ity arthaḥ / artham arthaṃ prati pratyartham / pratiśabdasya vīpsāyāṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāt tadyoge dvitīyāgarbhaṃ vākyam api / śaktim anatikramya yathāśakti / hareḥ sādṛśyaṃ sahari / vakṣyamāṇena sahasya saḥ / jyeṣṭhasyānupūrvyeṇety anujyeṣṭham / cakreṇa yugapad iti vigrahe /

SK 660 avyayībhāve cākāle (A 6.3.81)

sahasya saḥ syād avyayībhāve na tu kāle / sacakram / kāle tu sahapūrvāhṇam / sadṛśaḥ sakhyā sasakhi / yathārthatvenaiva siddhe punaḥ sādṛśyagrahaṇaṃ guṇabhūte 'pi sādṛśye yathā syād ity evamartham / kṣatrāṇāṃ saṃpattiḥ sakṣatram / ṛddhrr ādhikyaṃ samṛddhiḥ / anurūpa ātmabhāvaḥ saṃpattir iti bhedaḥ / tṛṇam apy aparityajya satṛṇamatti / sākasyenety arthaḥ / na tv atra tṛṇabhakṣaṇe tātparyam / ante / agnigranthaparyantam adhīte sāgni //

SK 661 yathāsādṛśye (A 2.1.7)

asādṛśye eva yathāśabdaḥ samasyate / teneha na yathā haris tathā haraḥ / harer upamānatvaṃ yathāśabdo dyotayati / tena sādṛśya iti vā yathārtha iti vā prāptaṃ niṣidhyate /

SK 662 yāvadavadhāraṇe (A 2.1.8)

yāvantaḥ ślokās tāvanto 'cyutapraṇāmā yāvacchlokam /

SK 663 suppratinā mātrārthe (A 2.1.9)

śākasya leśaḥ śākaprati / mātrārthe kim / vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati vidyotate vidyut /

SK 664 akṣaśalākāsaṃkhyāḥ pariṇā (A 2.1.10)

dyūtavyavahāre parājaya evāyaṃ samāsaḥ / akṣena viparītaṃ vṛttam akaṣapari / śalākāpari / ekapari /

SK 665 vibhāṣā (A 2.1.11)

adhikāro 'yam / etatsāmarthyād eva prācīnānāṃ nityasamāsatvam / supsupeti tu na nityasamāsaḥ / avyayam ityādisamāsavidhānāj jñāpakāt /

SK 666 apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā (A 2.1.12)

apaviṣṇu saṃsāraḥ apa viṣṇoḥ / pariviṣṇu pari viṣṇoḥ / bahirvanam bahir vanāt / prāgvanam prāg vanāt /

SK 667 āṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ (A 2.1.13)

etayor āṅ pañcamyantena vā samasyate sp 'vyayībhāvaḥ / āmukti saṃsāraḥ ā mukteḥ / ābālaṃ haribhaktiḥ ā bālebhyaḥ /

SK 668 lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye (A 2.1.14)

ābhimukhyadyotakāv abhipratī cihnavācinā saha prāgvat / abhyagni śalabhāḥ patanti agnim abhi / pratyagni agniṃ prati /

SK 669 anur yatsamayā (A 2.1.15)

yaṃ padārthaṃ samayā dyotyate tena lakṣaṇabhūtenānuḥ samasyate so 'vyayībhāvaḥ / anuvanam aśanirgataḥ / vanasya samīpaṃ gata ity arthaḥ /

SK 670 yasya cāyāmaḥ (A 2.1.16)

yasya dairdhyam anunā dyotyate tena lakṣaṇabhūtenānuḥ samasyate / anugaṅgaṃ vārāṇasī gaṅgāyā anu / gaṅgādairdhyasadṛśadairyopalakṣitety arthaḥ /

SK 671 tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīni ca (A 2.1.17)

SK 672 pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhyā vā (A 2.1.18)

pāramadhyaśabdau ṣaṣṭhyantena saha vā samasyete / edantatvaṃ cānayor nipātyate / pakṣe ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ / pāregaṅgād ānaya gaṅgāpārāt / madhyegaṅgāt gaṅgāmadhyāt / mahāvibhāṣayā vākyam api / gaṅgāyāḥ pārāt / gaṅgāyā madhyāt /

SK 673 saṃkhyā vaṃśyena (A 2.1.11)

vaṃśo dvidhā vidyayā janmanā ca / tatra bhavo vaṃśyaḥ / tadvācinā saha saṃkhyā vā samasyate / dvau mutī vaṃśyau dvimuni / vyākaraṇasya trimuni / vidyātadvatām abhedavivakṣāyāṃ trimuni vyākaraṇam / ekaviṃśati bhāradvājam /

SK 674 nadībhiś ca (A 2.1.20)

nadībhiḥ saha saṃkhyā prāgvat / samāhāre cāyam iṣyate / saptagaṅgam / dviyamunam /

SK 675 anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām (A 2.1.21)

anyapadārthe vidyamānaṃ subantaṃ nadībhiḥ saha nityaṃ samasyate saṃjñāyām / vibhāṣādhikāre 'pi vākyena saṃjñānavagamād iha nityasamāsaḥ / unmattagaṅgaṃ nāma deśaḥ / lohitagaṅgam /

SK 676 samāsāntāḥ (A 5.4.68)

ity adhikṛtya /

SK 677 avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ (A 5.4.107)

śaradādibhyaṣ ṭac syāt samāsānto 'vyayībhāve / śaradaḥ samīpam upaśaradam / prativipāśam / śarad / vipāś / anas / manas / upānah / div / himavat / anaḍuh / diś / dṛś / viś / cetas / catur / tyad / tad / yad / kiyat / jarāyā jaras ca / upajarasam / pratiparasamanubhyo 'kṣnaḥ / yasyeti ca / pratyakṣam / akṣṇaḥ param iti vigrahe samāsāntavidhānasāmarthyād avyayībhāvaḥ / parokṣe liṭ iti nipātanāt parasyaukārādeśaḥ / parokṣam / parokṣā kriyetyādi tu arśaādyaci / samakṣam / anvakṣam /

SK 678 anaś ca (A 5.4.108)

SK 679 nastaddhite (A 6.4.144)

SK 681 nadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ (A 5.4.110)

vā ṭac syāt / upanadam / upanadi / upapaurṇamāsam / upapaurṇamāsi / upāgrahāyaṇam / upāgrahāyaṇi /

SK 684 tatpuruṣaḥ (A 2.1.22)

SK 685 dviguś ca (A 2.1.23)

SK 686 dvitīyā śritātītapatitagatātyastaprāptāpannaiḥ (A 2.1.24)

dvitīyāntaṃ śritādiprakṛtikaiḥ subantaiḥ saha vā samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ / kṛṣṇaṃ śritaḥ kṛṣṇaśritaḥ / duḥkham atīto duḥkhātītaḥ / gamyādīnām upasaṃkhyānam / grāmaṃ gamī grāmagamī / annaṃ bubhukṣuḥ annabubhukṣuḥ //

SK 687 svayaṃ ktena (A 2.1.25)

dvitīyā iti na saṃbadhyate ayogyatvāt / svayaṃkṛtasyāpatyaṃ svāyaṃkṛtiḥ /

SK 688 khaṭvā kṣepe (A 2.1.26)

khaṭvāprakṛtikaṃ dvitīyāntaṃ ktāntaprakṛtikena subantena samasyate nindāyām / khaṭvārūḍho jālmaḥ / nityasamāso 'yam / na hi vākyena nindā gamyate /

SK 689 sāmi (A 2.1.27)

sāmikṛtam /

SK 690 kālāḥ (A 2.1.28)

ktenety eva / anatyantasaṃyogārthaṃ vacanam / māsaoramitaḥ pratipaccandraḥ / māsaṃ paricchettum ārabdhavān ity arthaḥ /

SK 691 atyantasaṃyoge ca (A 2.1.29)

SK 692 tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena guṇavacanena (A 2.1.30)

tatkṛteti luptatṛtīyākam / tṛtīyāntaṃ tṛtīyāntārthakṛtaguṇavacanenārthaśabdena ca saha prāgvat / śaṅkulayā khaṇḍaḥ śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḥ / dhānyenātho dhānyārthaḥ / tatkṛteti kim / akṣṇā kāṇaḥ /

SK 693 pūrvasadṛśasamonārthakalahanipuṇamiśraślakṣṇaiḥ (A 2.1.31)

tṛtīyāntam etaiḥ prāgvat / māsapūrvaḥ / mātṛsadṛśaḥ / pitṛsamaḥ / ūnārthe / māṣonaṃ kārṣāpaṇam / māṣavikalam / vākkalahaḥ / ācāranipuṇaḥ / guḍamiśraḥ / ācāraślakṣṇaḥ / miśragrahaṇe sopasargasyāpi grahaṇam / miśraṃ cānupasargam asandhau ity atrānupasargagrahaṇāt / guḍasaṃmiśrā dhānāḥ / avarasyopasaṃkhyānam / māsenāvaro māsāvaraḥ /

SK 694 kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam (A 2.1.32)

kartari karaṇe ca tṛtīyā kṛdantena bahulaṃ prāgvat / hariṇā trāto haritrātaḥ / nakhair bhinno nakhabhinnaḥ / kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam / nakhanirbhinnaḥ / kartṛkaraṇe iti kim / bhikṣābhir uṣitaḥ / hetāv eṣā tṛtīyā / bahulagrahaṇaṃ sarvopādhivyabhicārārtham / tena dātreṇa lūnavān ityādau na / kṛtā kim / kāṣṭhaiḥ pacatitarām /

SK 695 kṛtyair adhikārthavacane (A 2.1.33)

stutinindāphalakam arthavādavacanam adhikārthavacanaṃ tatra kartari karaṇe ca tṛtīyā kṛtyaiḥ prāgvat / vātacchedyaṃ tṛṇam / kākapeyā nadī /

SK 696 annena vyañjanam (A 2.1.34)

saṃskārakadravyavācakaṃ tṛtīyāntam annena prāgvat / dadhnā odano dadhyodanaḥ / ihāntarbhūtopasekakriyādvārā sāmarthyam /

SK 697 bhkṣyeṇa miśrīkaraṇam / (A 2.1.35)

SK 698 caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharākṣitaiḥ (A 2.1.36)

caturthyantārthāya yattadvācinārthādibhiś ca caturthyantaṃ vā prāgvat / tadarthena prakṛtivikṛtibhāva eva gṛhyate / balirakṣitagrahaṇāj jñāpakāt / yūpāya dāru yūpadāru / neha / randhanāya sthālī / aśvaghāsādayas tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ / arthena nityasamāso viśeṣyaliṅgatā ceti vaktavyam / dvijāyāyaṃ dvijārthaḥ sūpaḥ / dvijārthā yavāgūḥ / dvijārthaṃ payaḥ / bhūtabaliḥ / gohitam / gosukham / gorakṣitam /

SK 699 pañcamī bhayena (A 2.1.37)

corād bhayaṃ corabhayam / bhayabhītabhītibhībhir iti vācyam / vṛkabhītaḥ / vṛkabhītiḥ / vṛkabhīḥ /

SK 700 apetāpoḍhamuktapatitāpatrastair alpaśaḥ (A 2.1.38)

etaiḥ sahālpaṃ pañcamyantaṃ samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ / sukhāpetaḥ / kalpanāpoḍhaḥ / cakramuktaḥ / svargapatitaḥ / taraṅgāpatrastaḥ / alpaśaḥ kim / prāsādāt patitaḥ /

SK 701 stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena (A 2.1.39)

stokān muktaḥ / alpān muktaḥ / antikād āgataḥ / abhyāśād āgatāḥ / dūrād āgataḥ / viprakṛṣṭād āgatāḥ / kṛcchrād āgataḥ / pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ ity aluk /

SK 702 ṣaṣṭhī (A 2.2.8)

rājñaḥ puruṣo rājapuruṣaḥ /

SK 703 yājakādibhiś ca (A 2.2.9)

ebhiḥ ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ samasyate / tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari ity asya pratiprasavo 'yam / brāhmaṇayājakaḥ / devapūjakaḥ / guṇāntareṇa taralopaś ceti vaktavyam / tarabantaṃ yadguṇavāci tena saha samāsas tarappratyayalopaś ca / na nirdhāraṇe iti pūraṇaguṇa-iti ca niṣedhasya pratiprasavo 'yam / sarveṣāṃ śvetataraḥ sarvaśvetaḥ / sarveṣāṃ mahattaraḥ sarvamahān / kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti vācyam / idhm asya vraścanaḥ idhvam avraścanaḥ /

SK 704 na nirdhārane (A 2.2.10)

nirdhāraṇe yā ṣaṣṭhī sā na samasyate / nṛṇāṃ dvijaḥ śreṣṭaḥ / pratipadavidhānāṣaṣṭhī na samasyata iti vācyam / sarpiṣo jñānam /

SK 705 pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena (A 2.2.11)

pūrṇādyarthaiḥ sadādibhiś ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate / pūraṇe / satāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ / guṇe / kākasya kārṣṇyam / brāhmaṇasya śuklāḥ / yadā prakaraṇādinā dantā iti viśeṣyaṃ jñātaṃ tadedam udāharaṇam / anityo 'yaṃ guṇena niṣedhaḥ / tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt ityādinirdeśāt / tenārthagauravaṃ buddhimāndyam ityādi siddham / suhitārthās tṛptyarthāḥ / phalānāṃ suhitaḥ / tṛtīyāsamāsas tu syād eva / svare viśeṣaḥ / sat / dvijasya kurvankurvāṇo vā / kiṃkara ity arthaḥ / avyayam / brāhmaṇasya kṛtvā / pūrvottarasāhacaryāt kṛdavyayam eva gṛhayate / tena taduparītyādi siddham iti rakṣitaḥ / tavye / brāhmaṇasya kartavyam / tavyatā tu bhavaty eva / svakartavyam / svare bhedaḥ / samānādhikaraṇena / takṣakasya sarpasya / viśeṣaṇasamāsas tv iha bahulagrahaṇān na / gor dhenor ityādiṣu poṭāyuvati ityādīnāṃ vibhaktyantare caritārthānāṃ paratvād bādhakaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ prāptaḥ so 'py anena vāryate /

SK 706 ktena ca pūjāyām (A 2.2.12)

matibuddhi iti sūtreṇa vihito yaḥ ktas tadantena ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate / rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā / rājapūjita ityādau tu bhūte ktāntena saha tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ /

SK 707 adhikaraṇavācinā ca (A 2.2.13)

SK 708 karmaṇi ca (A 2.2.14)

SK 709 tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari  (A 2.2.15)

kartrarthatṛjakābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyā na samāsaḥ / apāṃ sraṣṭā / vajrasya bhartā / odanasya pācakaḥ / kartari kim / ikṣūṇāṃ bhakṣaṇam ikṣubhakṣikā / patyarthabhartṛśabdasya tu yājakāditvāt samāsaḥ / bhūbhartā / kathaṃ tarhi ghaṭānāṃ nirmātus tribhuvanavidhātuś ca kalaha iti / śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā samāsa iti kaiyaṭaḥ /

SK 710 kartari ca (A 2.2.16)

kartari ṣaṣṭhyā akena na samāsaḥ / bhavataḥ śāyikā / neha tṛj anuvartate / tadyoge kartur abhihitatvena kartṛṣaṣṭhyā abhāvāt /

SK 711 nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ (A 2.2.17)

etayor arthayor ekena nityaṃ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate / uddālakapuṣpabhañjikā / krīḍāviśeṣasya saṃjñā / saṃjñāyām iti bhāve ṇvul / jīvikāyāṃ / dantalekhakaḥ / tatra krīḍāyāṃ vikalpe jīvikāyāṃ tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari iti niṣedhe prāpte vacanam /

SK 712 pūrvāparādharottaram ekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe (A 2.2.1)

avayavinā saha pūrvādayaḥ samasyante ekatvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaś ced avayavī / ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādaḥ / pūrvaṃ kāyasya pūrvakāyaḥ / aparakāyaḥ / ekadeśinā kim / pūrvaṃ nābheḥ kāyasya / ekādhikaraṇe kim / pūrvaś chātrāṇām / sarvo 'py ekadeśo 'hnā samasyate  / saṃkhyāvisāya–iti jñāpakāt / madhyāhnaḥ / sāyāhnaḥ / kecit tu sarvo 'py ekadeśaḥ kālena samasyate na tv ahnaiva / jñāpakasya sāmānyāpekṣatvāt / tena madhyarātraḥ / upāratāḥ paścimarātragocarā ityādi siddham ity āhuḥ /

SK 713 ardhaṃ napuṃsakam (A 2.2.2)

samāṃśavācyardhaśabdo nityaṃ klībe sa prāgvat // ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭhyantavacanam // ekadeśisamāsaviṣayako 'yam upasarjanasaṃjñāniṣedhaḥ / tena pañcakhaṭvī ityādi siddhyati / ardhaṃ pippalyāḥ ardhapippalī / klībe kim / grāmārdhaḥ / dravyaikya eva / ardhaṃ pippalīnām /

SK 714 dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇy anyatrasyām (A 2.2.3)

etāny ekadeśinā saha prāgvad vā / dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyā dvitīyabhikā / ekadeśinā kim / dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyā bhikṣukasya / anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūraṇaguṇa–iti niṣedhaṃ bādhitvā pakṣe ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ / bhikṣādvitīyam /

SK 715 prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā (A 2.2.4)

pakṣe dvitīyāśritā–iti samāsaḥ / prāpto jīvikāṃ prāptajīvikaḥ / jīvikāprāptaḥ / āpannajīvikaḥ / jīvikāpannaḥ / iha sūtre dvitīyayā a iti chitvā akāro 'pi vidhīyate / tena jīvikāṃ prāptā strī prāptajīvikā / āpannajīvikā /

SK 716 kālāḥ parimāṇinā (A 2.2.5)

pariccheduavācinā subantena saha kālāḥ samasyante / māso jātasya yasya sa māsajātaḥ / dvyahajātaḥ / dvayor ahnoḥ samāhāro dvyahaḥ / dvyaho jātasya yasya sa iti vigrahaḥ / uttarapadena parimāṇinā dvigoḥ sidhaye bahūnāṃ tatpuruṣasyopasaṃkhyānam / dve ahanī jātasya yasya sa dvyahnajātaḥ / ahno 'hna–iti vakṣyamāṇo 'hnādeśaḥ / pūrvatra tu na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre iti niṣedhaḥ /

SK 717 saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ (A 2.1.40)

saptamyantaṃ śauṇḍādibhiḥ prāgvad vā / akṣeṣu śauṇḍaḥ akṣaśauṇḍaḥ / adhiśabdo 'tra paṭhyate / adhyuttarapadāt iti khaḥ / īśvarādhīnaḥ /

SK 718 siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiś ca (A 2.1.41)

SK 719 dhvāṅkṣeṇa kṣepe (A 2.1.42)

SK 720 kṛtyair ṛṇe (A 2.1.43)

saptamyantaṃ kṛtyapratyayāntaiḥ saha prāgvad āvaśyake / māsedeyaṃ ṛṇam / ṛṇagrahaṇaṃ niyogopalakṣaṇārtham / pūrvāhṇegeyaṃ sāma /

SK 721 saṃjñāyām (A 2.1.44)

saptamyantaṃ supā prāgvat saṃjñāyām / vākyena saṃjñānavagamān nityasamāso 'yam / araṇyetilakāḥ / vanekaserukāḥ / haladantāt saptamyā–ity aluk /

SK 722 ktenāhorātrāvayavāḥ (A 2.1.45)

hno rātreścāvayavāḥ saptamyantāḥ ktāntena saha prāgvat / pūrvāhṇakṛtam / apararātrakṛtam / avayavagrahaṇaṃ kim / ahni dṛṣṭam /

SK 723 tatra (A 2.1.46)

SK 724 kṣepe (A 2.1.47)

SK 725 pātresamitādayaś ca (A 2.1.48)

SK 726 pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇanavakevalāḥ samānādhikaraṇena (A 2.1.49)

viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa–iti siddhe pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ sūtram / ekaśabdasya diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām iti niyamabādhānārthaṃ ca / pūrvaṃ snātaḥ paścādanuliptaḥ snātānuliptaḥ / ekanāthaḥ / sarvayājñikāḥ / jaranneyāyikā / purāṇamīmāṃsakāḥ / navapāṭhakāḥ / kevalavaiyākaraṇāḥ /

SK 727 diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām (A 2.1.50)

SK 728 taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca (A 2.1.51)

SK 793 na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre (A 5.4.89)

SK 794 uttamaikābhyāṃ ca (A 5.4.90)

SK 797 grāmakauṭābhyāṃ ca takṣṇaḥ (A 5.4.95)

SK 801 nāvo dvigoḥ (A 5.4.99)

SK 804 dvitribhyām añcaleḥ (A 5.4.102)

SK 805 brahmaṇo jānapadākhyāyām (A 5.4.104)

SK 806 kumahadbhyām anyatarasyām (A 5.4.105)

SK 807 ānmahataḥ samānādhikaraṇajātīyayoḥ (A 6.3.46)

mahata ākāro 'ntādeśaḥ syāt samānādhikaraṇe uttarapade jātīye ca pare / mahābramnaḥ / mahābrahmā / mahādevaḥ / mahājātīyaḥ / samānādhikaraṇe kim /  mahataḥ sevā mahatsevā / lākṣaṇikaṃ vihāya pratipadoktaḥ sanmahat–iti samāso 'tra grahīṣyate cet mahābāhur na syāt / tasmāt lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasya iti paribhāṣā neha pravartate / samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇasāmarthyāt / ād iti yogavibhāgād ātvam / prāg ekādaśabhya iti nirdeśād vā / ekādaśa / mahatīśabdasya puṃvatkarmadhāraya–iti puṃvadbhāve kṛte ātvam / mahājātīyā / mahadātve ghāsakaraviśiṣṭeṣūpasaṃkhyānaṃ puṃvadbhāvaś ca / asāmānādhikaraṇyārtham idam / mahato mahatyā vā ghāso mahāghāsaḥ / mahākaraḥ / mahāviśiṣṭaḥ / aṣṭanaḥ kapāḷe haviṣi / aṣṭākapālaḥ / gavi ca yukte / gośabde pare yukta ity arthe gamye 'ṣṭana ātvaṃ vaktavyam ity arthaḥ / aṣṭāgavaṃ śakaṭam / acpratyanvava–ity atrāj iti yogavibhāgād bahuvrīhāv apy ac / aṣṭānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāraḥ aṣṭagavam / tadyuktatvāc chakaṭamaṣṭāgavam iti vā /

SK 808 dvyaṣṭanaḥ saṃkhyāyām abahuvrīhyaśītyoḥ (A 6.3.47)

āt syāt / dvau ca daśa ca dvādaśa / dvyadhikā deśeti vā / dvāviṃśatiḥ / aṣṭādaśa / aṣṭāviṃśatiḥ / abahuvrīhyaśītyoḥ kim / dvitrāḥ / dvyaśītiḥ / prāk śatād iti vaktavyam / neha / dviśatam / dvisahasram /

SK 809 trestrayaḥ (A 6.3.48)

SK 810 vibhāṣā catvāriṃśatprabhṛtau sarveṣām (A 6.3.49)

SK 811 ekādiś caikasya cāduk (A 6.3.76)

ekādir  nañ prakṛtyā syād ekasya ca adugāgamaś ca / naño viṃśatyā saha samāse kṛte ekaśabdena saha tṛtīyeti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ / anunāsikavikalpaḥ / ekena naviṃśatiḥ / ekān naviṃśatiḥ / ekādanaviṃśatiḥ / ekonaviṃśatir ity arthaḥ / ṣaṣa utvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsūttarapadādeḥ ṣṭutvaṃ ca dhāsu veti vācyam / ṣōḍan / ṣoḍaśa / ṣōḍḥā / ṣaḍdhā /

SK 812 paravilliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ (A 2.4.26)

etayoḥ parapadasyeva liṅgaṃ syāt / kukkuṭamayūruāvime / mayūrīkukkuṭāvimau / ardhapippalī / dviguprāptāpannālaṃpūrvagatisamāseṣu pratiṣedho vācyaḥ / pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapālaḥ puroḍāśaḥ / prāpto jīvikāṃ prāptajīvikaḥ / āpannajīvikaḥ / alaṃ kumāryai alaṃkumāriḥ / ata eva jñāpakāt samāsaḥ / niṣkauśāmbiḥ /

SK 813 pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau (A 2.4.27)

SK 814 rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi (A 2.4.29)

SK 815 apathaṃ napuṃsakam (A 2.4.30)

SK 817 jātyākhyāyām ekasmin bahuvacanam anyatarasyām (A 1.2.58)

SK 818 asmado dvayoś ca (A 1.2.59)

SK 819 phalgunīproṣṭhapadānāṃ ca nakṣatre (A 1.2.60)

SK 820 tiṣyapunarvasvor nakṣatradvandve bahuvacanasya dvivacanaṃ nityam (A 1.2.63)

SK 821 sa napuṃsakam (A 2.4.17)

samāhāre dvigur dvandvaś ca napuṃsakaṃ syāt / paravalliṅgāpavādaḥ / pañcagavam / dantoṣṭam / akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyām iṣṭaḥ / pañcamūlī / ābanto vā / pañcakhaṭvī / pañcakhaṭvam / ano nalopaś ca vā dviguḥ striyām / pañcatakṣī / pañcatakṣam / pātrādyantasya na // paścapātram / tribhuvanam / caturyugam / puṇyasudinābhyām ahnaḥ klībateṣṭā / puṇyāham / sudināham / pathaḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ / saṃkhyāvyāyādeḥ paraḥ kṛtasamāsāntaḥ pathaśabdaḥ klībam ity arthaḥ / trayāṇāṃ panthāstripatham / virūpaḥ panthāḥ vipatham / kṛtasamāsāntanirdeśān neha / supanthāḥ / atipanthāḥ / sāmānye napuṃsakam / mṛdu pacati / prātaḥ kamanīyam /

SK 822 tatpuruṣo 'nañkarmadhārayaḥ (A 2.4.19)

SK 823 saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu (A 2.4.20)

SK 824 upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām (A 1.4.21)

SK 825 chāyā bāhulye (A 2.4.22)

SK 826 sabhā rājāmanuṣyapūrvā (A 2.4.23)

SK 827 aśālā ca (A 2.4.24)

SK 828 vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām (A 2.4.25)

etadantas tatpuruṣaḥ klībaṃ vā syāt / brāhmaṇasenam / brāhmaṇasenā / yavasuram / yavasurā / kuḍyacchāyam / kuḍyacchāyā / gośālā / śvaniśam / śvaniśā / tatpuruṣo 'nañkarmadhāraya–ity anuvṛtter neha / dṛḍhaseno rājā / asenā / paramasenā //

SK 829 śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ (A 2.2.23)

adhikāro 'yam / dvitīyāśrita–ityādinā yasya trikasya viśiṣya samāso noktaḥ sa śeṣaḥ prathamāntam ity arthaḥ /

SK 830 anekam anyapadārthe (A 2.2.24)

anekaṃ prathamāntam anyasya padasyārthe vartamānaṃ vā samasyate sa bahuvrīhiḥ / aprathamā vibhaktyarthe bahuvrīhir iti samānādhikaraṇānām iti ca phalitam / prāptam udakaṃ yaṃ prāptodako grāmaḥ / ūḍaratho 'naḍvān / upahṛtapaśū rudraḥ / uddhṛtaudanā sthālī / pītāmbaro hariḥ / vīrapuruṣako grāmaḥ / prathamārthe tu na / vṛṣṭe deve gataḥ / vyadhikaraṇānām api na / pañcabhir bhuktam asya / prādibhyo dhātujasya vācyo vā cottaraoadalopaḥ / prapatitaparṇaḥ praparṇaḥ / naño 'styarthānāṃ vācyo vā cottarapadalopaḥ / avidyamānaputraḥ aputraḥ / astīti vibhaktipratirūpakam avyayam / astikṣīrā gauḥ /

SK 831 striyāṃ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ samānādhikaraṇe striyām apūraṇīpriyādiṣu (A 6.3.34)

bhāṣītapuṃskād anūṅ ūṅo 'bhāvo yasyām iti bahuvrīhiḥ / nipātanāt pañcamyā aluk ṣaṣṭhyāś ca luk / tulye pravṛttinimitte yaduktapuṃskaṃ tasmāt para ūṅo 'bhāvo yatra tathābhūtasya strīvācakaśabdasya puṃvācakasyeva rūpaṃ syāt samānādhikaraṇe strīliṅge uttarapade na tu pūraṇyāṃ priyādau ca parataḥ / gostriyoḥ–iti hrasvaḥ / citrā gāvo yasyeti laukikavigrahe / citrā as go as ity alaukikavigrahe / citraguḥ / rūpavadbhāryaḥ / citrā jaratī gaur yasyeti vigrahe anekokter bahūnām api bahuvrīhiḥ / atra kecit / citrājaratīguḥ / jaratīcitrāgur vā / evaṃ dīrghātanvījaṅghaḥ / tanvīdīrghājaṅghaḥ / tripade bahuvrīhau prathamaṃ na puṃvat / uttarapadasya madhyamena vyavadhānāt / dvitīyam api na puṃvat / pūrvapadatvābhāvāt / uttaraoadaśabdo hi samāsasya caramāvayave rūḍhaḥ / pūrvapadaśabdas tu prathamāvayave rūḍha iti vadanti / vastutas tu neha pūrvapadam ākṣipyate / ānaṅ ṛtaḥ–ity atra yathā / tenopāntyasya puṃvad eva / citrājaradgur ityādi / ata eva citrājaratyau gāvau yasyeti dvandvagarbhe 'pi citrājaradgur iti bhāṣyam / karmadhārayottarapade tu citrajaradgavīkaḥ / striyāḥ kim / grāmaṇi kulaṃ dṛṣṭir asya grāmaṇidṛṣṭiḥ / bhāṣitapuṃskāt kim / gaṅgābhāryaḥ / anūṅ kim / vāmorūbhāryaḥ / samānādhikaraṇe kim / kalyāṇyāḥ mātā kalyāṇīmātā / striyāṃ kim / kalyāṇī pradhānaṃ yasya sa kalyāṇīpradhānaḥ / pūraṇyāṃ tu /

SK 832 appūraṇīprabhāṇyoḥ (A 5.4.116)

pūraṇārthapratyayāntaṃ yat strīliṅgaṃ tadantāt pramāṇyantāc ca bahuvrīher ap syāt / kasyāṇī pañcamī yāsāṃ rātrīṇāṃ tāḥ kalyāṇīpañcamā rātrayaḥ / strī pramāṇī yasya sa strīpramāṇaḥ / puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho 'ppratyayaś ca pradhānapūraṇyām eva / rātriḥ pūraṇī vācyā cety uktodāharaṇe mukhyā / anyatra tu /

SK 833 nadyṛtaś ca (A 5.4.143)

SK 835 na kapi (A 7.4.14)

kapi pare hrasvo na syāt / kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣaḥ / atra tirohitāvayavabhedasya pakṣasyānyapadārthatayā rātrir apradhānam / abhukartṛkaḥ / apriyādiṣu kim / kalyāṇīpriyaḥ / priyā / manojñā / kalyāṇī / subhagā / durbhagā / bhaktiḥ / sacivā / svasā / kāntā / kṣāntā / samā / capalā / duhitā / vāmā / abalā / tanayā / sāmānye napuṃsakam / dṛḍhaṃ bhaktir yasya sa dṛḍhabhaktiḥ / strītvavivakṣāyāṃ tu dṛḍhābhaktiḥ /

SK 836 tasilādiṣv ākṛtvasucaḥ (A 6.3.35)

tasilādiṣu kṛtvasujanteṣu pareṣu striyāḥ puṃvat syāt / parigaṇanaṃ kartavyam / avyāptyativyāptiparihārāya / tratasau / taraptamapau / caraḍjātīyarau / kalpabdeśīyarau / rūpappāśapa / thāl / tilthyanau / bahvīṣu bahutra / bahutaḥ / darśanīyatarā / darśanīyatamā / gharūpa–iti vakṣyamāṇo hrasvaḥ paratvāt puṃvadbhāvaṃ bdhate / paṭvitarā / paṭvitamā / paṭucarī / paṭujātīyā darśanīyakalpā / darśanīyadeśīyā / darśanīyarūpā / darśanīyapāśā / bahuthā / praśastā vṛkī vṛkatiḥ / ajābhyo hitā ajathyā / śasi bahvakpārthasya puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ / bahvībhyo dehi bahuśaḥ / alpābhyo dehi alpaśaḥ / tvatalor guṇavacanasya / śuklāyā bhāvaḥ śuklatvam / śuklatā / guṇavacanasya kim / kartyā bhāvaḥ kartrītvam / śaradaḥ kṛtārthatetyādau tu sāmānye napuṃsakam / bhasyāḍhe taddhite / hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikam / aḍhe kim / rauhiṇeyaḥ / strībhyo ḍhak iti ḍho 'tra gṛhyate / agner ḍhak iti ḍhak tu puṃvad eva / agnāyī devatāsya sthālīpākasvāgneyaḥ / sapatnīśabdas tridhā / śatruparyāyāt sapatnaśabdāc chārṅgaravāditvāt ṅīnyekaḥ / samānaḥ patir yasyāiti vigrahe vivāhanibandhanaṃ patiśabdam āśritya nityastrīliṅgo dvitīyaḥ / svāmiparyāyapatiśabdena bhāṣitapuṃskas tṛtīyaḥ / ādyayoḥ śivādyaṇ / sapatnyā apatyaṃ sāpatnaḥ / tṛtīyāt tu liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā patyuttarapadalakṣaṇo ṇy eva na tvaṇ / śivādau rūḍhayor eva grahaṇāt / sāpatyaḥ / ṭhakchasoś ca / bhavatyāś chātrā bhāvatkāḥ / bhavadīyāḥ / etadvārtikam ekataddhite ca iti sūtraṃ ca na kartavyam / sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ iti bhāṣyakāreṣṭyā gatārthatvāt / sarvamayaḥ / sarvakāmyati / sarvikā bhāryā yasya sa sarvakabhāryaḥ / sarvapriya ityādi / pūrvasyaivedam / bhastraiṣājājñād vā iti liṅgāt / tenākaci ekaśeṣavṛttau ca na / sarvikā / sarvāḥ / kukkuṭyādīnām aṇḍādiṣu / kukkuṭyā aṇḍaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍam / mṛgyāḥ padaṃ mṛgapadam / mṛgakṣīram / kākaśāvaḥ /

SK 846 tatra tenedam iti sarūpe (A 2.2.27)

SK 847 or guṇaḥ (A 6.4.146)

śeṣād iti prāptaḥ kap na syāt saṃjñāyām / viśve devā asya viśvedevaḥ /

SK 894 īyasaś ca (A 5.4.146)

īyasantottarapadān na kap / bahavaḥ śreyāṃso 'sya bahuśreyān / gostriyoḥ iti hrasve prāpte / īyaso bahuvrīher neti vācyam / bahvayaḥ śreyasyo 'sya bahuśreyasī / bahuvrīheḥ kim / atiśreyasiḥ /

SK 895 vandine bhrātuḥ (A 5.4.147)

pūjite 'rthe yo bhrātṛśabdas tadantān na kap syāt / praśasto bhrātā yasya praśastabhrātā / na pūjanāt iti niṣedhas tu bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ ity ataḥ prāg eveti vakṣyate / bandite kim / mūrkhabhrātṛkaḥ /

SK 896 nāḍītantryo svāṅge (A 5.4.159)

svāṅge yau nāḍītantrīśabdau tadantāt kap na syāt / bahunāḍiḥ kāyaḥ / bahutantrīr grīvā / tantrīr dhamanī / strīpratyayāntatvābhāvād dhrasvo na / svāṅge kim / bahunāḍīkaḥ stambhaḥ / bahuta strīkā vīṇā /

SK 897 niṣpravāṇiś ca (A 5.4.160)

kababhāvo 'tra nipātyate / prapūrvādvayater lyuṭ / pravāṇī tantuvāyaśalākā / nirgatā pravāṇyasya niṣpravāṇiḥ paṭaḥ / samāptavānaḥ / navaḥ ity arthaḥ /

SK 898 saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau (A 2.2.37)

saptamyantaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ ca bahuvrīhau pūrvaṃ prayojyam / kaṇṭhekālaḥ / ata eva jñāpakād vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ / citraguḥ / dviśuklaḥ / mitho 'nayoḥ samāse saṃkhyā pūrvaṃ śabdaparavipratiṣedhāt / dvyanyaḥ / saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ / dvitrāḥ / dvandve 'pi / dvādaśa / vā priyasya / guḍapriyaḥ / priyaguḍaḥ / gaḍvādeḥ parā saptamī / gaḍukaṇṭhaḥ / kvacin na / vahegaḍuḥ /

SK 899 niṣṭhā (A 2.2.36)

niṣṭhāntaṃ bahuvrīhau pūrvaṃ syāt / kṛtakṛtyaḥ / jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ parā niṣṭhā vācyā / sāraṅgajagdhī / māsajātā / sukhajātā / prāyikaṃ cedam / kṛtakaṭaḥ / pīnodakaḥ /

SK 900 vāhitāgnyādiṣu (A 2.2.37)

āhitāgniḥ / agnyāhitaḥ / ākṛtigaṇo 'yam / praharaṇārthebhyaḥ pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau / abhyudyataḥ / daṇḍapāṇiḥ / kvacin na / vivṛtāmiḥ /

iti bahuvrīhiprakaraṇam //

dvandvaprakaraṇam 20 //

SK 901 cārthe dvandvaḥ (A 2.2.29)

anekaṃ subantaṃ cārthe vartamānaṃ v samasyate sa dvandvaḥ / samuccayānvācayetaretarayogasamāhārās cārthāḥ / parasparanirapekṣasyānekasya ekasminn anvayaḥ samuccayaḥ / anyatarasyānuṣaṅgikatve 'nvācayaḥ / militānām anvaya itaretarayogaḥ / samūhaḥ samāhāraḥ / tatreśvaraṃ guruṃ ca bhajasveti samuccaye / bhikṣāmaṭa gāṃ cānayety anvācaye ca na samāso 'sāmarthyāt / dhavakhadīrau / saṃjñāparibhāṣam / anekokter hotṛpotṛneṣṭodgātāraḥ / dvayor dvayor dvandvaṃ kṛtvā punardvandve tu hotāpotāneṣṭodgātāraḥ /

SK 902 rājadantādiṣu param (A 2.2.31)

eṣu pūrvaprayogārhaṃ paraṃ syāt / dantānāṃ rājā rājadantaḥ / dharmādiṣv aniyamaḥ / arthadharmau / dharmārthau / dampatī / jampatī / jāyāpatī / jāyāabdasya jambhāvo dambhāvaś ca vā nipāyate / ākṛtigaṇo 'yam /

SK 903 dvandve ghi (A 2.2.32)

dvandve ghisaṃjñaṃ pūrvaṃ syāt / hariś ca haraś ca hariharau / anekaprāptāv ekatra niyamo 'niyamaḥ śeṣe / hariguruharāḥ / hariharaguravaḥ /

SK 904 ajādyadantam (A 2.2.33)

idaṃ dvandve pūrvaṃ syāt / īśakṛṣṇau / bahuṣv aniyamaḥ / aśvarathendrāḥ / indrāśvarathāḥ / dhyantād ajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedhena / indrāgnī /

SK 905 alpāctaram (A 2.2.34)

śivakeśavau / ṛtunakṣatrāṇāṃ samākṣarāṇām ānupūrvyeṇa / hemantaśiśiravasantāḥ / kṛttikārohiṇyau / samākṣarāṇāṃ kim / grīṣmavasantau / laghvakṣaraṃ pūrvam / kuśakāśam / abhyarhitaṃ ca / tāpasaparvatau / varṇānām ānupūrvyeṇa / brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāḥ / bhrātur jyāyasaḥ / yudhiṣṭirārjunau /

SK 906 dvandvaś prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām (A 2.4.2)

eṣāṃ dvandva ekavat syāt / pāṇipādam / mārdaṅgikapāṇavikam / rathikāśvāroham / samāhārasyaikatvād ekatve siddhe niyamārthaṃ prakaraṇam / prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eva yathā syāt /

SK 907 anuvāde caraṇānām (A 2.4.3)

caraṇānāṃ dvandva ekavat syāt siddhasyopanyāse / stheṇor luṅīti vaktavyam / udagāt kaṭhakālāpam / pratyaṣṭhāt kaṭhakauthumam /

SK 908 adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam (A 2.4.4)

yajurvede vihito yaḥ ṛtus tadvācinām anapuṃsakaliṅgānāṃ dvandva ekavat syāt / arkāśvamedham / adhvaryukratuḥ kim / iṣuvajrau sāmavede vihitau / anapuṃsakaṃ kim / rājasūyavājapeye / ardharcādī /

SK 909 adhyayanato 'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām (A 2.4.5)

adhyayanena pratyāsannā ākhyā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dvandva ekavat / padakakramakam /

SK 910 jātir aprāninām (A 2.4.6)

prāṇibarjyajātivācināṃ dvandva ekavat / dhānāśaṣkuli / prāṇināṃ tu virūśūdrāḥ / dravyajātīnām eva / neha / rūparasau / gamanākuñcane / jātiprādhānya evāyam ekavadbhāvaḥ / dravyaviśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ tu badarāmalakāni /

SK 911 viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo 'grāmāḥ (A 2.4.7)
grāmavarjyanadīdeśavācināṃ bhinnaliṅgānāṃ samāhāre dvandva ekavat syāt / uddhyaś ca irāvatīṃ ca uddhyerāvati / gaṅgā ca śoṇaś ca gaṅgāśoṇam / kuravaś ca kurukṣetraṃ ca kurukurukṣetram / bhinnaliṅgānāṃ kim / gaṅgāyamune / madrakekayāḥ / agrāmāḥ kim / jāmbavaṃ nagaram / śālūkinī grāmaḥ / jāmbavaśālūjinyau /

SK 912 kṣudrajantavaḥ (A 2.4.8)

eṣāṃ samāhāre dvandva ekavat syāt / yūkālikṣam / ā nakulāt kṣudrajantavaḥ /

SK 913 yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ (A 2.4.9)

eṣāṃ grāgvat / ahinakulam / govyāghram / kākolūkam ityādau paratvāt vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛga–iti prāptaṃ cakāreṇa bādhyate /

SK 914 śūdrāṇām aniravasitānām (A 2.4.10)

abahiṣkṛtānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ prāgvat / takṣāyaskāram / pātrād bahiṣkṛtānāṃ tu caṇḍālamṛtapāḥ /

SK 915 gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca (A 2.4.11)

yathoccāritāni sādhūni syuḥ / gavāśvam / dāsīdāsam ityādi /

SK 916 vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharottarāṇām (A 2.4.12)

vṛkṣādīnāṃ saptānāṃ dvandvaḥ / aśvavaḍavetyādidvandvatrayaṃ ca prāgvad vā / vṛkṣādau viśeṣāṇām eva grahaṇam / plakñanyagrodham / plakṣanyagrodhāḥ / rurupṛṣatam / rurupṛṣatāḥ / kuśakāśam / kuśakāśāḥ / vrīhiyavam / vrīhiyavāḥ / dadhighṛtam / dadhighṛte / gomahiṣam / gomahiṣāḥ / śukabakam / śukabakāḥ / aśvavaḍavam / aśvavaḍavau / pūrvāparam / pūrvāpare / adharottaram / adharottare / phalasenāṅgavanaspatimṛgaśakunikṣudrajantudhāntatṛṇānāṃ bahuprakṛtir eva dvandva ekavad iti vācyam / badarāṇi cāmalakāni ca badarāmalakam / jātir aprāṇinām ity ekavadbhāvaḥ / neha / badarāmalake / rathikāśvārohau / plakṣanyagrodhau / ityādi / vibhāṣāvṛkṣa–iti sūtre ye 'grāṇinas teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ jātir aprāṇinām iti nitye prāpte vikalpārtham / paśugrahaṇam hastyaśvādiṣu senāṅgatvān nitye prāpte / mṛgāṇāṃ mṛgair eva śakunīnāṃ tair evobhayatra dvandvaḥ / anyais tu sahetaretarayoga eveti niyamārthaṃ mṛgaśakunigrahaṇam / evaṃ pūrvāparamadharottaram ity api / aśvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ tu pakṣe napuṃsakatvārtham / anyathā paratvāt pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau iti syāt /

SK 917 vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci (A 2.4.13)

viruddhārthānām adravyavācināṃ dvandva ekavad vā syāt / śītoṣṇam / śītoṣṇe / vaikalpikaḥ samāhāradvandvaḥ cārthe dvandvaḥ iti sūtreṇa prāptaḥ sa viruddhārthānāṃ yadi bhavati tarhi adravyavācinām eveti niyamārtham idam / tena dravyavācinām itaretarayoga eva / śītoṣṇe udake staḥ / vipratiṣiddhaṃ kim / nandakapāñcajanyau / iha pākṣikaḥ samāhāradvandvo bhavaty eva /

SK 918 na dadhipayaādīni ca (A 2.4.14)

etāni naikavat syuḥ / dadhipayasī / idhmābarhipī / nipātanād dīrghaḥ / ṛksāme / bāṅmanase /

SK 919 adhikaraṇaitāvattve ca (A 2.4.15)

dravyasaṃkhyāvagame ekavad eveti niyamo na syāt / daśa dantoṣṭhāḥ /

SK 920 vibhāṣā samīpe (A 2.4.16)

adhikaraṇaitāvattvasya sāmīpyena paricchede samāhāra evety evaṃrūpo niyamo vā syāt / upadaśaṃ dantoṣṭham / upadaśā dantoṣṭhāḥ /

SK 921 ānaṅ ṛto dvandve (A 6.3.25)

vidyāyonisaṃbandhavācinām ṛdantānāṃ dvandve ānaṅ syād uttarapade pare / hotāpetārau / hotṛpotṛneṣṭodgātāraḥ / mātāpitarau / putre 'nyatarasyām ity ato maṇḍūkaplutyā putra ity anuvṛtteḥ / pitāputrau /

SK 922 devatādvandve ca (A 6.3.26)

ihottarapade pare ānaṅ / mitrāvaruṇau / vāyuśabdaprayoge pratiṣedhaḥ / agnivāyū / vāyvagnī / punardvandvagrahaṇaṃ prasiddhasāhacaryasya parigrahārtham / tena brahmaprajāpatī ityādau nānāṅ / etad dhi naikahavirbhāgitvena śrutaṃ nāpi loke prasiddhaṃ sāhacaryam /

SK 923 īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ (A 6.3.27)

devatādvanve ity eva /

SK 924 agneḥ stutstomasomāḥ (A 8.3.82)

agneḥ pareṣām eṣāṃ sasya paḥ syāt samāse / agniṣṭut / agniṣṭomaḥ / agnīṣomau / agnīvaruṇau /

SK 925 idvṛddhau (A 6.3.28)

vṛddhimatyuttarapade agner idādeśaḥ syād devatādvandve / agnāmarutau devate asya āgnimārutaṃ karma / agnīvaruṇau devate asya āgnivāruṇam / devatādvandve ca ity ubhayapadavṛddhiḥ / alaukike vākye ānaṅmītvaṃ ca bādhitvā it / vṛddhau kim / āgnendraḥ / nendrasya parasya ity uttarapadavṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ / viṣṇau na / āgnāvaiṣṇavam /

SK 926 divo dyāvā (A 6.3.29)

devatādvandve uttarapade / dyāvābhūmī / dyāvākṣāmā /

SK 927 divasaś ca pṛthivyām (A 6.3.30)

diva ity eva / cād dyāvā / ādeśe akāroccāraṇaṃ sakārasya rutvaṃ mābhūd ity etadartham / dyauś ca pṛthivī ca divas pṛthivyau / dyāvāpṛthivyau / dhandasi dṛṣṭānuvidhiḥ / dyāvā cidasmai pṛthivī / divaspṛthivyoraratim ity atra padakārā visargaṃ paṭhanti /

SK 928 uṣāsoṣasaḥ (A 6.3.31)

uṣasśabdasyoṣāsādeśo devatādvandve / uṣāsāsūryam /

SK 929 mātarapitarāv udīcām (A 6.3.22)

mātarapitarau / udīcāṃ kim / mātāpitarau /

SK 930 dvandvāc cudaṣahāntāt samāhāre (A 5.4.106)

cacargāntād daṣahāntāc ca dvandvāṭ ṭac syāt samāhāre / vāk ca tvak ca vāktvacam / tvaksrajam / śamīdṛṣadam / vāktviṣam / chatropānaham / samāhāre kim / prāvṛṭśaradau /

iti dvandvaprakaraṇam //

ekaśeṣaprakaraṇam 21 //

athaikaśeṣaḥ / sarūpāṇām– / rāmau / rāmāḥ / virūpānām api samānārthānām / vakradaṇḍaś ca kuṭiladaṇḍaś ca vakradaṇḍau / kuṭiladaṇḍau /

SK 931 vṛddho yūnā tallakṣaṇaś cedeva viśeṣaḥ (A 1.2.65)

yūnā sahoktau gotraṃ śiṣyate gotrayuvapratyayamātrakṛtaṃ cettayoḥ kṛtsnaṃ vairūpyaṃ syāt / gārgyaś ca gārgyāṃyaṇaś ca gārgyau / vṛddhaḥ kim / bhāgavittibhāgavittikau / kṛtsnaṃ kim / gārgyavātsyāyanau /

SK 932 strī puṃvac ca (A 1.2.66)

yūnā sahoktau vṛddhā strī śiṣyate tadarthaś ca puṃvat / gārgī ca gārgyāyaṇau ca gargāḥ / astriyām ity anuvartamāne yaññoś ca iti luk / dākṣī ca dākṣāyaṇaś ca dākṣī /

SK 933 pumān striyā (A 1.2.67)

striyā sahoktau pumān śiṣyate tallakṣaṇa eva viśeṣaś cet / haṃsī ca haṃsaś ca haṃsau /

SK 934 bhrātṛputrau svamṛduhitṛbhyām (A 1.2.68)

bhrātā ca svasā ca bhrātarau / putraś ca duhitā ca putrau /

SK 935 napuṃsakam anapuṃsakenaikavac cāsyānyatarasyām (A 1.2.69)

aklībena sahoktau klībaṃ śiṣyate tac ca vā ekavat syāt tallakṣaṇa eva viśeṣaś cet / śuklaḥ paṭaḥ / śuklā śāṭī / śuklaṃ vastram / tad idaṃ śuklam / tānīmāni śuklāni /

SK 936 pitā mātrā (A 1.2.70)

mātrā sahoktau pitā vā śiṣyate / mātā ca pitā ca pitarau / mātāpitarau /

SK 937 śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā (A 1.2.71)

śvaśrvā sahoktau śvaśuro vā śiṣyate tallakṣaṇa eva viśeṣaś cet / śvaśrūś ca śvaśūraś ca śvaśurau / śvaśrūśvaśurau /

SK 938 tyadādīni sarvair nityam (A 1.2.72)

sarvaiḥ sahoktau tyādādīni nityaṃ śiṣyante / sa ca devadattaś ca tau / tyadādīnāṃ mithaḥ sahktau yatparaṃ tac chiṣyate / sa ca yaś ca yau / pūrvaśeṣo 'pi dṛśyata iti bhāṣyam / sa ca yaś ca tau / tyadāditaḥ śeṣa puṃnapuṃsakato liṅgavacanāni / sā ca devadattaś ca tau / tac ca devadattaś ca yajñadattā ca tāni / puṃnapuṃsakayos tu paratvān napuṃsakaṃ śiṣyate / tac ca devadattaś ca te / advandvatatpuruṣaviśeṣaṇānām iti vaktavyam / kukkuṭamayūryāv ime / mayūrīkukkuṭav imau / tac ca sā ca ardhapiṣpalyau te /

SK 939 grāmyapaśusaṅgheṣv ataruṇeṣu strī (A 1.2.73)

eṣu sahavivakṣāyāṃ strī śiṣyate / pūmān striyā ity asyāpavādaḥ / gāva imāḥ / grāmyeti kim / rurava ime / paśugrahaṇaṃ kim / brāhmaṇāḥ / saṅgheṣu kim / etau gāvau / ataruṇeṣu kim / vatsā ime / anekaśapheṣv iti vācyam / aśvā ime / iha sarvatra ekaśeṣe kṛte 'nekasubantābhāvād dvandvo na / tena śirasī śirāṃsītyādau samāsasyety antodāttaḥ prāṇyaṅgatvād ekavadbhāvaś ca na / panthānau panthāna ityādau samāsānto na /

ity ekaśeṣaprakaraṇam //

sarvasamāsaśeṣaprakaraṇam 22 //

kṛttaddhitasamāsaikaśeṣasanādyantadhāturūpāḥ pañca vṛttayaḥ / parārthābhidhānaṃ vṛttiḥ / vṛttyarthāvabidhakaṃ vākyaṃ vigrahaḥ / sa dvividhiḥ / laukiko 'laukikaś ca / pariniṣṭhitatvāt sādhur laukikaḥ / prayogānarho 'sādhur alaukikaḥ / yathā / rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ / rājan as puruṣa su iti / avigraho nityasamāsaḥ / asvapadavigraho vā / samāsaś caturvidha iti tu prāyovdaḥ / avyayībhāvatatpuruṣabahuvrīhidvandvādhikārabahirbhūtānām api saha supā iti samāsavidhānāt / pūrvapadārthapradhāno 'vyayībhāvaḥ / uttarapadārthapradhānas tatpuruṣaḥ / anyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiḥ / ubhayapadārthapradāno dvandvaḥ / ity api prācāṃ vādaḥ prāyo 'bhiprāyaḥ / sūpaprati unmattagaṅgam ityādyavyayībhāve atimālādau tatpuruṣe dvitrā ityādibahuvrīhau dantoṣṭham ityādidvandve cābhāvāt / tatpuruṣaviśeṣaḥ karmadhārayaḥ / tadviśeṣo dviguḥ / anekapadatvaṃ dvandvabahuvrīhyor eva / tatpuruṣasya kvacid evety uktam / kiṃca / supāṃ supā tiṅā nāmnā dhātunātha tiṅāṃ tiṅā / subanteneti vijñeyaḥ samāsaḥ ṣaḍvidho budhaiḥ // 1 //  supāṃ supā / rājapuruṣaḥ / tiṅā / paryabhūṣat / nāmnā / kumbhakārāḥ / dhātunā / kaṭaprūḥ / ajasram / tiṅāṃ tiṅā / pibatasvādatā / svādatamodatā / tiṅāṃ supā kṛntavicakṣaṇeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā kṛntavicakṣaṇā / ehīḍādayo 'nyapadārthe iti mayūravyaṃsakādau pāṭhāt samāsaḥ /

iti sarvasamāsaśeṣaprakaraṇam //

samāsāntaprakaraṇam 23 //

SK 940 ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe (A 5.4.74)

a anakṣa iti cchedaḥ / ṛgādyantasya samāsasya apratyayo 'ntāvayavaḥ syāt akṣe yā dhūs tadantasya tu na / ardharcaḥ / anṛcabahvṛcāvadhyetary eva / neha anṛksāma / bahvṛk sūktam / viṣṇoḥ pūḥ viṣṇupuram / klībatvaṃ lokāt / vimalāpaṃ saraḥ //

SK 941 dvyantarupasargebhyo 'pa īt (A 6.3.97)

apa iti kṛtasamāsāntasyānukaraṇam / ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā / ebhyo 'pasya īt syāt / dvirgatā āpo yasminn iti dvīpam / antarīpam / pratīpam / samīpam / samāpo devayajanam iti tu samā āpo yasminn iti bodhyam / kṛtasamāsāntagrahaṇān neha /  svap / avarṇāntād vā / prepam / parepam / prāpam / parāpam /

SK 942 ūdanor deśe (A 6.3.98)

anoḥ parasyāpasya ūt syād deśe / anṛpo deśaḥ / rājadhurā / akṣe tu akṣadhūḥ / dṛḍhadhūrakṣaḥ / sakhipathaḥ / ramyapatho deśaḥ /

SK 943 ac pratyanvavapūrvāt sāmalomnaḥ (A 5.4.75)

SK 2734 pūrvavat sanaḥ (A 1.3.62)

SK 2735 propābhyāṃ yujer ayajñapātreṣu (A 1.3.64)

SK 2738 ṇer aṇau yatkarma ṇau cet sa kartānādhyāne (A 1.3.67)

ṇyantād ātmanepadaṃ syād aṇau yā kriyā saiva cet ṇyantenocyeta aṇau yatkarmakārakaṃ sa ceṇ ṇau kartā syān na tv anādhyāne / ṇicaś ca iti siddhe 'kartrabhiprāyārtham idam / kartrabhiprāye tu vibhāṣopapadena iti vikalpe aṇāv akarmakāt iti parasmaipade ca paratvāt prāpte pūrvavipratiṣedhenedam eveṣyate / kartṛsthabhāvakāḥ kartṛsthakriyāś codāharaṇam / tathā hi / paśyanti bhavaṃ bhaktāḥ / cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayaṃ kurvantīty arthaḥ / preraṇāṃśatyāge / paśyati bhavaḥ / viṣayo bhavatīty arthaḥ / tato hetumaṇṇic / darśayanti bhavaṃ bhaktāḥ / paśyantīty arthaḥ / punar ṇyarthasyāvivakṣāyāṃ darśayate bhavaḥ / iha prathamatṛtīyayor avasthayor dvitīyacaturthyoś ca tulyo 'rthaḥ / tatra tṛtīyakakṣāyāṃ na taṅ / kriyāsāmye 'py aṇau karmakākarasya ṇau kartṛtvābhāvāt / caturthyā tu taṅ / dvitīyām ādāya kriyāsāmyāt / prathamāyāṃ karmaṇo bhavasyeha kartṛtvāc ca / evam ārohayate hastīty udāharaṇam / ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ / nyagbhāvayantīty arthaḥ / tata ārohati hastī / nyagbhavatīty arthaḥ / tato ṇic / ārohantīty arthaḥ / tata ārohayate / nyagbhavatīty arthaḥ / yad vā paśyanty ārohantīti prathamakakṣā prāgvat / tataḥ karmaṇa eva hetutvāropāṇ ṇic / darśayati bhavaḥ / ārohayati hastī / paśyata ārohataś ca prerayatīty arthaḥ / tato ṇijbhyāṃ tatprakṛtibhyāṃ ca upāttayor api preṣaṇayos tyāge / darśayate ārohayate ity udāharaṇam / arthaḥ prāgvat / asmin pakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ na taṅ / samānakriyātvābhāvāṇ ṇijarthasyādhikyāt / anādhyāne kim / smarati vanagulmaṃ kokilaḥ / smarayati vanagulmaḥ / utkaṇṭhāpūrvakasmṛtau viṣayo bhavatīty arthaḥ / bhīsmyor hetubhaye vyākhāyatam /

SK 2739 gṛdhivañcayoḥ pralambhane (A 1.3.69)

SK 2761 āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ (A 7.3.33)

ādantānāṃ yugāgamaḥ syāc ciṇi ñiti ṇiti kṛti ca / dāyitā / dātā / dāyiṣīṣṭa / dāsīṣṭa / adāyi / adāyiṣātām / sthādhvor ic ca / adiṣātām / adhāyiṣātām / adhiṣātām / aglāyiṣātām / aglāsātām / hanyate / aciṇṇaloḥ ity ukter hanasto na / h hanteḥ---iti kutvam / ghānitā / hantā / / ghāniṣyate / haniṣyate / āśīrliṅi vadhādeśasyāpavādaś ciṇvadbhāvaḥ / ārdhadhātuke sīyuṭīti viśeṣavihitatvāt / ghāniṣīṣṭa / pakṣe vadhiṣīṣṭa / aghāni / aghāniṣātām / ahasātām / pakṣe vadhādeśaḥ / avadhi / avadhiṣātām / aghāniṣyate / ahaniṣyata / na ca syādiṣu ciṇvad ity atideśād vadhādeśaḥ syād iti vācyam / aṅgasya ity adhikārādāṅgasyaivātideśāt / gṛhyate / ciṇvad iṭo na dīrghatvam / prakṛtasya balādiakṣaṇasyaiveṭo graho 'liṭi---ity anena dīrghavidhānāt / grāhitā / grahītā / grāhiṣyate / grahīṣyate / grāhiṣīṣṭa / grahiṣīṣṭa / agrāhi / agrāhiṣātām / agrahīṣātām / dṛśyate / adarśi / adarśiṣātām / sicaḥ kittvād am na / adṛkṣātām / girater luṅi dhvami caturadhikaṃ śatam / tathā hi / ciṇvad iṭo dīrgho nety uktam / agāridhvam / dvitīye tv iṭi vṝto vā iti vā dīrghaḥ / agarīdhvam / agaridhvam / eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ latvaṃ ḍhatvaṃ dvitvatrayaṃ ceti pañca vaikalpikāni / itthaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiḥ / liṅsicoḥ iti vikalpatvād iḍbhāve uś ca iti kittvam / raparatvaṃ hali ca iti dīrghaḥ / iṇaḥ ṣīdhvaṃ---iti nityaṃ ḍhatvam / aśīrḍhvam / ḍhavamānāṃ dvitvavikalpe aṣṭau / uktaṣaṇṇavatyā saha saṃkalane uktā saṃkhyeti / iḍ dīrghaś ciṇ vad iṭ latvaṃ ḍhatvaṃ dvitvatrikaṃ tathā / ity aṣṭānāṃ vikalpena caturbhir adhikaṃ śatam / hetumaṇṇyantāt karmaṇi laḥ / yak / ṇilopaḥ / śamyate moho mukundane

SK 2762 ciṇṇamulor dīrgho 'nyatarasyām (A 6.4.93)

ciṇpare ṇamulpare ca ṇau mitām upadhāyā dīrgho vā syāt / prakṛto mitāṃ hrasvaḥ eva tu na vikalpitaḥ / ṇyantāṇ ṇau hrasvavikalpasyāsiddheḥ / dīrghavidhau hi ṇico lopo na sthānivad iti dīrghaḥ sidhyati / hrasvavidhau tu sthānivattvaṃ durvāram / bhāṣye tu pūrvatrāsiddhīye na sthānivad ity avaṣṭabhya dvirvacanasavarṇānusvāradīrghajaścaraḥ pratyākhyātāḥ / ṇāv iti jātiparā nirdeśaḥ / dīrghagrahaṇaṃ māstu iti tadāśayaḥ / śāmitā / śamitā / śamayitā / śāmiṣyate / śamiṣyate / śamayiṣyate / yaṅantāṇ ṇic / śaṃśamyate / śaṃśāmitā / śaṃśamitā / śaṃśamayitā / yaṅlugantāṇ ṇicy apy evam / bhāṣyamate tu yaṅantāc ciṇvad iṭi dīrgho nāstīti viśeṣaḥ / ṇyantatvābhāve śamyate muninā /

SK 2763 nodāttopadeśasya māntasyānācameḥ (A 7.3.34)

SK 2765 vibhāṣā ciṇṇamuloḥ (A 7.1.69)

SK 2766 karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ (A 3.1.87)

karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavat syāt / kāryātideśo 'yam / tena yagātmanepadaciṇciṇvad iṭaḥ syuḥ / kartur abhihitatvāt prathamā / pacyate odanaḥ / bhdyate kāṣṭham / apāci / abhedi / nanu bhāve lakāre kartur dvitīyā syād asmād atideśād iti cen na / lakāravācya eva kartā karmavat / vyatyayo bahulaṃ liṅyāśiṣyaṅ iti dvilakārakāl la ity anuvṛtteḥ / bhāve pratyaye ca kartur lakāreṇānupasthiteḥ / ata eva kṛtyaktakhalārthāḥ karmakartari na bhavanti / kiṃ tu bhāve eva / bhettavyaṃ kusūlena / nanu pacibhidyoḥ karmasthā kriyā vikḷttir dvidhābhavanaṃ ca / saivedānīṃ kartṛsthā na tu tattulyā / satyam / karmatvakartṛtvāvasthābhedopādhikaṃ tatsamānādhikaraṇakriyāyā bhedam āśritya vyavahāraḥ / karmaṇeti kim / karaṇādhikaraṇābhyāṃ tulyakriye pūrvokte sādhvasir ityādau mā bhūt / kiṃca / kartṛsthakriyebhyo mā bhūt / gacchati grāmaḥ / ārohati hastī / adhigacchati śāstrārthaḥ smarati śraddadhāti ca / yatra karmaṇi kriyākṛto viśeṣo dṛśyate yathā pakveṣu taṇḍuleṣu yathā vā chinneṣu kāṣṭheṣu tatra karmasthā kriyā netaratra / na hi pakvāpakvataṇḍuleṣv iva gatāgatagrāmeṣu vailakṣaṇyam upalabhyate / karotir utpādanārthaḥ / utpattiś ca karmasthā / jñānecchādivad yatnasya kartṛsthatvāt / etena anuvyavasyamāne 'pi iti vyākhyātam / kartṛsthatvena yagabhāvāc chyani kṛte olope ca rūpasiddheḥ / tācchīlyādāvayaṃ cānaś na tv ātmanepadam / sakarmakāṇāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ / anyonyaṃ spṛśataḥ / ajā grāmaṃ nayati / duhipracyor bahulaṃ sakarmakayor iti vācyam /
