atha svaraprakaraṇaśeṣāḥ 72 //

SK 3708 ādyudāttaś ca (A 3.1.3)

pratyaya ādyudātta eva syāt / agniḥ / kartavyam /

SK 3709 anudāttau suppitau (A 3.1.4)

pūrvasyāpavādaḥ / yajñasya / na yo yucchati / śaptipor anudāttatve svaritapracayau /

SK 3710 citaḥ (A 6.1.63)

anta udāttaḥ syāt / citaḥ saprakṛter bahvakajartham / citi pratyaye sati prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyānta udātt vācya ity arthaḥ / nabhantāmanyake same / yake sarasvatīm anu / takatsute /

SK 3711 taddhitasya (A 6.1.164)

citas taddhitasyānta udāttaḥ / pūrveṇa siddhe ñitsvarabādhanārtham idam / kauñjāyanāḥ /

SK 3712 kitaḥ (A 6.1.165)

kitas taddhitasyānta udāttaḥ / yadāgneyaḥ .

SK 3713 tisṛbhyo jasaḥ (A 6.1.166)

anta udāttaḥ / tisro dyāvaḥ savituḥ /

SK 3714 sāvekācas tṛtīyādir vibhaktiḥ (A 6.1.168)

sāviti saptamībahuvacanam / tatra ya ekāc tataḥ parā tṛtīyādir vibhaktir udāttā / vācā virūpaḥ / sau kim / rājñetyādau ekāco 'pi rājaśabdāt parasya mā bhūt / rājño nu te / ekācaḥ kim / vidhate rājani tve / tṛtīyādiḥ kim / na dadarśa vācam /

SK 3715 antodāttād uttarapadād anyatarasyām anityasamāse (A 6.1.169)

nityādhikāravihitasamāsād anyatra yad uttarapadam antodāttam ekāc tataḥ parā tṛtīyādir vibhakrir udāttā vā syāt / paramavācā /

SK 3716 añceś chandasy asarvanāmasthānam (A 6.1.170)

añceḥ parā vibhaktir udāttā / indro dadhīcaḥ / cāv iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvaṃ prāptam / tṛtīyādir ity anuvartamāne asarvanāmasthānagrahaṇaṃ śasparigrahārtham / pratīco bahūnū /

SK 3717 ūḍidampadādyappumredyubhyaḥ (A 6.1.171)

ebhyo 'sarvanāmasthānavibhaktir udāttā / praṣṭhauhaḥ / praṣṭhauhā / ūṭhyupadhāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam / iha mā bhūt / akṣadyuvā / akṣadyuve / idam / ebhir nṛbhir nṛtamaḥ / anvādeśe na / antodāttād ity anuvṛtteḥ / na ca tatrāntodāttatāpy astīti vācyam / idamonvādeśe 'śanudāttas tṛtīyādau iti sūtreṇānudāttasya aśo vidhānāt / pra te babhrū / mābhyāṃ gā anu / paddannomāshṛnniś iti ṣaṭ padādayaḥ / padbhyāṃ bhūmiḥ / dadbhir na jihvā / aharaharjāyate māsimāsi / manaś cimne hṛda ā / ap / apāṃ phenena / pum / abhrāteva puṃsaḥ / rai / rāyā vayam / rāyo dhartā vivasvataḥ / div / upa tvāgne divedive /

SK 3718 aṣṭano dīrghāt (A 6.1.172)

śasādir vibhaktir udāttā / aṣṭābhir daśabhiḥ /

SK 3719 śaturanumo nadyajādī (A 6.1.173)

anum yaḥ śatṛpratyayas tadantād antodāttāt parā nadī ajādiś ca śasādir vibhaktir udāttā syāt / acchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī / kṛṇvate / antodāttāt kim / dadhatī / abhyastānām ādiḥ ity ādyudāttaḥ / anumaḥ kim / tudantī / ekādeśo 'tra udāttaḥ / adupadeśāt paratvāc chatuḥ lasārvadhātuka iti nighātaḥ /

SK 3720 udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt (A 6.1.174)

udāttasthāne yo yaṇ halpūrvas tasmāt parā nadī śasādir vibhaktiś ca udāttā syāt / codayitrī sūnṛtānām / eṣā netrī / ṛtaṃ devāya kṛṇvate savitre /

SK 3721 noṅdhātvoḥ (A 6.1.175)

anayor yaṇaḥ pare śasādaya udāttā na syuḥ / brahmabandhvā / setpṛśniḥ subhve /

SK 3722 hrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup (A 6.1.176)

hrasvāntād antodāttān nuṭaś ca paro matub udāttaḥ / yo abdimāṃl udanimāṃl iyarti / nuṭaḥ / akṣaṇvantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyaḥ / antodāttāt kim / mā tvā vidadiṣumān / svaravidhau vyañjanam avidyamānavad ity etad atra na / marutvān indra / niyutvān vāyavā gahi / reśabdāc ca / revāṃl idrevataḥ /

SK 3723 nām anyatarasyām (A 6.1.177)

matupi yo hrasvas tadantād antodāttāt paro nām udātto vā / cetantī sumatīnām /

SK 3724 ṅyāś chandasi bahulam (A 6.1.178)

SK 3725 ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ (A 6.1.179)

hrasvānta uttarapade samāse vāntyāt pūrvam udāttaṃ kapi nañsubhyāṃ paraṃ bahuvrīhau / avrīhikaḥ / sumāṣakaḥ / pūrvam ity anuvartamāne punaḥ pūrvagrahaṇaṃ pravṛttibhedena niyamārtham / hrasvānte 'ntyād eva pūrvapadam udāttaṃ na kapi pūrvam iti / ajñakaḥ / kabantasyaivāntodāttatvam /

SK 3909 bahor nañvad uttarapadabhūmni (A 6.2.175)

SK 3910 na guṇādayo 'vayavāḥ (A 6.2.176)

SK 3911 upasargāt svāṅgaṃ dhruvam aparśu (A 6.2.177)

SK 3912 vanaṃ samāse (A 6.2.178)

SK 3913 antaḥ (A 6.2.179)

SK 3914 antaś ca (A 6.2.180)

SK 3916 na nivibhyām (A 6.2.181)

SK 3917 parer abhitobhāvi maṇḍalam (A 6.2.182)

SK 3921 sphigapūtavīṇāñjodhvakṛkṣisīranāmanāma ca (A 6.2.187)

SK 3922 adher uparistham (A 6.2.188)

SK 3923 atorapradhānakanīyasī (A 6.2.189)

SK 3924 puruṣaś cānvādiṣu (A 6.2.190)

SK 3925 ater akṛtpade (A 6.2.191)

SK 3926 ner anidhāṇe (A 6.2.192)

SK 3927 prater aṃśvādayas tatpuruṣe (A 6.2.193)

SK 3928 upād dvyajajinamagaurādayaḥ (A 6.2.194)

SK 3929 soravakṣepaṇe (A 6.2.195)

SK 3930 vibhāṣotpucche (A 6.2.196)

tatpuruṣe / utkrāntaḥ pucchād utpucchaḥ / yadā tu puccham udasyati utpucchayateḥ er ac---utpucchas tadā thāthādisvareṇa nityam antodāttatve prāpte vikalpo 'yam / seyam ubhayatra vibhāṣā / tatpuruṣe kim / udas taṃ pucchaṃ yenaṃ sa utpucchaḥ /

SK 3931 dvitribhyāṃ pādṛnmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau (A 6.2.197)

ābhyāṃ pareṣv eṣv antodātto vā / dvipāc catuṣpāc ca sthāya / tripād ūrdhvaḥ / dvidan / trimūrdhānaṃ saptaraśmim / mūrdhann ity akṛtasamāsānta eva mūrdhaśabdaḥ / tasyaitatprayojanam asaty api samāsānte antodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt / etad eva jñāpakam anityaḥ samāsānto bhavatīti / yady api ca samāsāntaḥ kriyate tathāpi bahuvrīhikāryatvāt tadekadeśatvāc ca samāsāntodāttatvaṃ pakṣe bhavaty eva / dvimūrdhaḥ / trimūrdhaḥ / dvitribhyāṃ kim / kalyāṇamūrdhā / bahuvrīhau kim / dvayor mūrdhā dvimūrdhā /

SK 3932 sakthaṃ cākrāntāt (A 6.2.198)

gaurasakthaḥ / ślakṣṇasakthaḥ / ākrāntāt kim / cakrasakthaḥ / samāsāntasya pacaś cittvān nityam evāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati /

SK 3933 parādiś chandasi bahulam (A 6.2.199)

chandasi parasya sakthaśabdasyādir udātto vā / ajisaktham ālabheta / atra vārtikam / parādiś ca parāntaś ca pūrvāntaś cāpi dṛśyate / pūrvādayaś ca dṛśyante vyatyayo bahulaṃ tataḥ / iti parādiḥ / tuvijātā urukṣayā / parāntaḥ / ni yena muṣṭihatyayā / yastricakraḥ / pūrvāntaḥ / viśvāyur dhehi / iti samāsasvarāḥ /

tiṅantasvarāḥ 93 //

SK 3934 tiṅo gotrādīni kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoḥ (A 8.1.27)

SK 3935 tiṅṅ atiṅaḥ (A 8.1.28)

SK 3938 naha pratyārambhe (A 8.1.31)

SK 3939 satyaṃ praśne (A 8.1.32)

SK 3940 aṅgāprātilomye (A 8.1.33)

SK 3941 hi ca (A 8.1.34)

SK 3942 chandasy anekam api sākāṅkṣam (A 8.1.35)

SK 3944 pūjāyāṃ nāntaram (A 8.1.37)

SK 3945 upasargavyapetaṃ ca (A 8.1.38)

SK 3946 tupaśyapaśyatāhaiḥ pūjāyām (A 8.1.39)

SK 3949 purā ca parīpsāyām (A 8.1.42)

SK 3950 nanv ity anujñaiṣaṇāyām (A 8.1.43)

SK 3951 kiṃ kriyāpraśne 'nupasargam apratiṣiddham (A 8.1.44)

SK 3953 ehi manye prahāse lṛṭ (A 8.1.46)

SK 3955 kiṃvṛttaṃ ca ciduttaram (A 8.1.48)

SK 3956 āho utāho cānantaram (A 8.1.49)

SK 3957 śeṣe vibhāṣā (A 8.1.50)

SK 3958 gatyarthaloṭā lṛṇ na cet kārakaṃ sarvānyat (A 8.1.51)

gatyarthānāṃ loṭā yuktaṃ tiṅantaṃ nānudāttaṃ yatraiva kārake loṭ tatraiva lṛḍ api cet / āgaccha deva grāmaṃ drakṣyasyenam / uhyantāṃ devadattena śālayo rāmeṇa bhokṣyante / gatyarthe kim / paca deva odanaṃ bhokṣyase 'nnam / loṭā kim / āgaccher deva grāmaṃ drakṣyasyenam / lṛṭ kim / āgaccha deva grāmaṃ paśyasyenam / na ced iti kim / āgaccha deva grāmaṃ pitā te odanaṃ bhokṣyate / sarvaṃ kim / āgaccha deva grāmaṃ tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca drakṣyāva enam ity atrāpi nighātaniṣedho yathāsyāt / yalloḍantasya kārakaṃ ta cānyac ca lṛḍantenocyate /

SK 3959 loṭ ca (A 8.1.52)

SK 3960 vibhāṣitaṃ sopasargam anuttamam (A 8.1.53)

SK 3962 āma ekāntaram āmantritam anantike (A 8.1.55)

SK 3963 yaddhituparaṃ chandasi (A 8.1.56)

SK 3964 canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣv agateḥ (A 8.1.57)

SK 3965 cādiṣu ca (A 8.1.58)

SK 3966 cavāyoge prahamā (A 8.1.59)

SK 3969 cāhalopa evety avadhāraṇam (A 8.1.62)

SK 3970 cādilope vibhāṣā (A 8.1.63)

SK 3971 vaivāveti ca chandasiḥ (A 8.1.64)

SK 3972 ekānyābhyāṃ samarthābhyām (A 8.1.65)

SK 3973 yadvṛttān nityam (A 8.1.66)

yatra pade yacchabdas tataḥ paraṃ tiṅantaṃ nānudāttam / yo bhuṅkte yadadryaṅvāyur vāti / atra vyavahite kāryam iṣyate /

SK 3974 pūjanāt pūjitam anudāttaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ (A 8.1.67)

pūjanebhyaḥ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ pūjitavacanam anudāttam / kāṣṭhādhyāpakaḥ / malopaś ca vaktavyaḥ / dāruṇādhyāpakaḥ / ajñātādhyāpakaḥ / samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaḥ / etatsamāse iṣyate / neha / dāruṇam adhyāpaka iti vṛttimatam / pūjanād ity eva pūjitagrahaṇe siddhe pūjitagrahaṇam anantarapūjitalābhārtham / etad eva jñāpakam atra prakaraṇe pañcamīnirdeśe 'pi nānantaryam āśrīyata iti /

SK 3975 sagatir api tiṅ (A 8.1.68)

pūjanebhyaḥ kāṣṭhādibhyas tiṅantaṃ pūjitam anudāttam / yatkāṣṭhāṃ prapacati / tiṅṅ atiṅaḥ iti nighātasya nipātair yat---iti niṣedhe prāpte nidhir ayam / sagatigrahaṇāc ca gatir api nihanyate / gatigrahaṇe upasargagrahaṇam iṣyate / neha / yatkāṣṭhāṃ śuklīkaroti /

SK 3976 kutsane ca supy agotrādau (A 8.1.69)

kutsane ca subante pare sagatir agatir api tiṅ anudāttaḥ / pacati pūti / prapacati pūti / pacati mithyā / kutsane kim / prapacati śobhanam / supi kim / pacatikliśnāti / agotrādau kim / pacati gotram / kriyākutsana iti vaktavyam / kartuḥ kutsane mā bhūt / pacati / pūtir devadattaḥ / pūtiś cānubandha iti vācyam / tenāyaṃ cakārānubandhatvād antodāttaḥ / vā bahvartham anudāttam iti vācyam / pacanti pūti /

SK 3977 gatir gatau (A 8.1.70)

anudāttaḥ / abhyuddharati / gatiḥ kim / dattaḥ pacati / gatau kim / āmandrair indra haribhir yāhi manyūraromabhiḥ /

SK 3978 tiṅi codāttavati (A 8.1.71)

gatir anudāttaḥ / yatprapacati / tiṅgrahaṇam udāttavataḥ parimāṇārtham / anyathā hi yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayas taṃ praty eva gatis tatra dhātāv evodāttavati syāt pratyaye na syāt / udāttavati kim / prapacati / iti tiṅantasvarāḥ /

svarasaṃcāraprakāraḥ 74

atha vaidikavākyeṣu svarasaṃcāraprakāraḥ kathyate / agnimīḷe iti prathamā ṛk / tatrāgniśabdo 'vyutpattipakṣe phiṣaḥ ity antodātta iti mādhavaḥ / vastutas tu ghṛtāditvāt / vyutpattau tu nitpratyayasvareṇa / am suptvād anudāttaḥ / ami pūrvaḥ ity ekādeśas tu ekādeśa udāttena---ity udāttaḥ / īḷe / tiṅṅ antiṅaḥ iti nighātaḥ / saṃhitāyāṃ udāttād anudāttasya---itīkāraḥ svaritaḥ / svaritāt saṃhitām---iti ḷe ity asya pracayāparaparyāyā ekaśrutiḥ / puraḥśabdo 'ntodāttaḥ / pūrvādharāvarāṇām---ity asipratyayasvarāt / hitaśabdo 'pi dhāño niṣṭhāyāṃ dadhāter hiḥ---iti hyādeśe pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ / puro 'vyayam---itisaṃjñāyāṃ kugati---iti samāse samāsāntodātte tatpuruṣe tulyārtha---ity avyayapūrvapadaprrakṛtisvare gatikārakopapadāt kṛt---iti kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvare thāthādisvare ca pūrvapūrvopamardena prāpte gatir anantaraḥ iti pūrvapadaprakṛisvaraḥ / puraḥśabdokārasya saṃhitāyāṃ pracaye prāpte udāttasvaritaparasya sannataraḥ ity anudāttataraḥ / jañasya / naṅaḥ pratyayasvaraḥ / vibhakteḥ suptvād anudāttatve svaritatvam / devam / pacādyac / phiṭsvareṇa pratyayasvareṇa vāntodāttaḥ / ṛtvikśabdaḥ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttaḥ / hotṛśabdas tṛnpratyayānto nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ / ratnaśabdo 'nabviṣayasya ity ādyudāttaḥ / ratnāni dadhātīti ratnadhāḥ / samāsasvareṇa kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa vāntodāttaḥ / tamapaḥ pittvād anudāttatve svaritapracayāv ityādi yathāśāstram unneyam / iti svarasaṃcāraḥ /

itthaṃ vaidikaśabdānāṃ diṅmātram iha darśitam /
tad astu prītaye śrīmadbhavānīviśvanāthayoḥ // 1//

iti siddhāntakaumudyāṃ śrībhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ vaidikasvaraprakriyā //

puṃnapuṃsakādhikāraḥ /

175 puṃnapuṃsakayoḥ / adhikāro 'yam / 176 dhṛtabhūtamustakṣvelitairāvatapustakabustalohitaḥ / ayaṃ ghṛtaḥ / idaṃ ghṛtam / 177 śṛṅgārghanidāghodyamaśalyadṛḍhāḥ / ayaṃ śṛṅgaḥ / idaṃ śṛṅgam / 178 vrajakuñjakuthakūrcaprasthadarpārbhārdharcadarbhapucchāḥ / ayaṃ vrajaḥ / idaṃ vrajam / 179 kabandhauṣadhāyudhāntāḥ / spaṣṭam / 180 daṇḍamaṇḍakhaṇḍaśavasaindhavapārśvākāśakuśakāśāṅkuśakuliśāḥ / ete puṃnapuṃsakayoḥ syuḥ / kuśo rāmasute darbhe yoktre dvīpe kuśaṃ jale / iti viśvaḥ / śalākāvācī tu striyām / tathā ca jānapada iti sūtreṇāyovikāre ṅīṣi kuśī / dāruṇi tu ṭāp / kuśā vānaspatyāḥ stha tā mā pāteti śrutiḥ / ataḥ kṛkami---iti sūtre kuśākarṇīṣv iti prayogaś ca / vyāsasūtre ca / hānau tūpāyanaśabde śeṣatvāt kuśāc chanda iti / tatra śārīrakabhāṣye 'py evam / evaṃ ca śrutisūtrabhāṣyāṇām ekavākyatve sthite ācchanda ity āṅpraśleṣādiparo bhāmatīgranthaḥ prauḍhivādamātrapara iti vibhāvanīyaṃ bahuśrutaiḥ / 181 gṛhamehadehapaṭṭapaṭahāṣṭāpadāmbudakakudāś ca / iti puṃnapuṃsakādhikāraḥ / 182 aviśiṣṭaliṅgam / 183 avyayaṃ katiyuṣmadah / 184 ṣṇāntā saṃkhyā / śiṣṭā paravat / ekaḥ puruṣaḥ / ekā strī / ekaṃ kulam / 185 guṇavacanaṃ ca / śuklaḥ paṭaḥ / śuklā paṭī / śuklaṃ vstram / 186 kṛtyāś ca / 187 karaṇādhikaraṇayor lyuṭ ca / 188 sarvādīni sarvanāmāni / spaṣṭārtheyaṃ trisūtrī / iti liṅgānuśāsanaṃ samāptam /

iti śrībhaṭṭojidīkṣitaviracitā vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntakaumudī saṃpūrnā //

apavarṇaṃ ca bhakṣitam / na tasya pāṭhe mokṣo 'sti pāpāher iva kilbiṣāt / 50 / sutīrthād āgataṃ vyaktaṃ svāmnāyyaṃ suvyavasthitam / susvareṇa suvaktreṇa prayuktaṃ brahma rājate / 51 / mantro hīnaḥ svarato varṇato vā mithyāprayukto na tam artham āha / sa vāgvrajo yajamānaṃ hinasti yathendraśatruḥ svarato 'parādhāt / 52 / anakṣaraṃ hatāyuṣyaṃ vikharaṃ vyādhipīḍitam / akṣatā śastrarūpeṇa vajraṃ patati mastake / 53 / hastahīnaṃ tu yo 'dhīte svaravarṇavivarjitam / ṛgyajuḥsāmabhir dagdho viyonim adhigacchati / 55 // 10 // śaṃkaraḥ śāṃkarī prādād dākṣīputrāya dhīmate / vāṅmayebhyaḥ samāhṛtya devī vācam iti sthitiḥ / 56 / yenākṣarasamāmnāyam adhigamya maheśvarāt / kṛtsnaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ proktaṃ tasmai pāṇinaye namaḥ / 57 / yena dhautā giraḥ puṃsā vimalaiḥ śabdavāribhiḥ / tamaś cājñānajaṃ bhinnaṃ tasmai pāṇinaye namaḥ / 58 / ājñānāndhasya lokasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā / cakṣur unmīlitaṃ yena tasmai pāṇinaye namaḥ / 59 / trinayanam abhimukhaniḥsṛtām imāṃ ya iha paṭhet prayataś ca sadā dvijaḥ / sa bhavati dhanadhānyapaśuputrakīrtimānatulaṃ ca sukhaṃ samaśnute divīti divīti / 60 // 11 // atha śikṣām ātmodāttaśca hakāraṃ svarāṇāṃ yathā gotyacospṛṣṭodāttaṃ cāṣas tu śaṃkara ekādaśa // iti pāṇinīyaśikṣā samāptā //
